b: The people of love said to me:
If God tests you with this passion,
Know its station is lofty and precious;
Even the scholars are left bewildered by it
There is no true love without Union,
And no Union that is not dearly won.
There is no wine unless it be the sealed vintage,
And no spiritual station unless it reaches the heights.
As I lay deep in my slumber,
The Men of God stood over me.
They said to me: Arise, O sleeper,
And remember your Eternal Lord.
The people tell me I am misguided
Yet my path is already carved and clear.
For if I am made pure with my Lord,
Then the judgment of man is of no concern.
The dawn has broken upon my Beloved,
Until I beheld Him with my very eyes.
You alone are my quest, O my God,
And You have more right to me than I have to myself.

f: وَنَا دَاخِلْ عَالَأعْتَابُ وَعَلَى القُبَّةِ الخَضْرَا
b: As I enter upon the thresholds and beneath the green dome

f: نَظْرَةْ نَظْرَةْ يَاسِيدِي كِرْمَالْ عَلِي وَالزَّهْرَا
b: A glance, a glance, O my master, for the sake of Ali رضي الله عنه and Zahra

f: بَاللّه نَظْرَةْ يَا جَدَّاهْ كِرْمَالْ عَلِي وَالزَّهْرَا
b: By God, a glance, O grandfather, for the sake of Ali رضي الله عنه and Zahra

f: وَنَا لَمْدَحْ مُحْمَّدْ وَابُو بَكِرِ الصِدِّيقِ
b: And I praise Muhammad and Abu Bakr رضي الله عنه the Truthful

f: بِاللَّه نَظْرَةْ يَا سِيدِي يَا صَاحِبَ التَحْقِيقِ
b: By God, a glance, O my master, O possessor of realization

f: وَنَا دَاخِلْ عَالَأعْتَابُ وَعَلَى القُبَّةِ الخَضْرَا
b: As I enter upon the thresholds and beneath the green dome

f: نَظْرَةْ نَظْرَةْ يَاسِيدِي كِرْمَالْ عَلِي وَالزَّهْرَا
b: A glance, a glance, O my master, for the sake of Ali رضي الله عنه and Zahra

f: بَاللّه نَظْرَةْ يَا جَدَّاهْ كِرْمَالْ عَلِي وَالزَّهْرَا
b: By God, a glance, O grandfather, for the sake of Ali رضي الله عنه and Zahra

f: وَنَا لَمْدَحْ مُحَمَّدْ وَعُمَرْ يَا ابْنَ الخَطَّابِ
b: And I praise Muhammad and Umar ibn al-Khattab رضي الله عنه

f: بِاللّه نَظْرَةْ يَا سِيدِي يَا مُلْهَمْ لِلْصَوَابِ
b: By God, a glance, O my master, O inspired with righteousness

f: وَنَا دَاخِلْ عَالَأعْتَابُ وَعَلَى القُبَّةِ الخَضْرَا
b: As I enter upon the thresholds and beneath the green dome

f: نَظْرَةْ نَظْرَةْ يَاسِيدِي كِرْمَالْ عَلِي وَالزَّهْرَا
b: A glance, a glance, O my master, for the sake of Ali رضي الله عنه and Zahra

f: بَاللّه نَظْرَةْ يَا جَدَّاهْ كِرْمَالْ عَلِي وَالزَّهْرَا
b: By God, a glance, O grandfather, for the sake of Ali رضي الله عنه and Zahra

f: وَنَا لَمْدَحْ مُحَمَّدْ وَعُثْمَانِ ابْنَ العَفَّانِ
b: And I praise Muhammad and Uthman ibn Affan رضي الله عنه

f: بِاللّه نَظْرَةْ يَا سِيدِي يَا جَامِعَ القُرْآنِ
b: By God, a glance, O my master, O compiler of the Quran

f: وَنَا دَاخِلْ عَالَأعْتَابُ وَعَلَى القُبَّةِ الخَضْرَا
b: As I enter upon the thresholds and beneath the green dome

f: نَظْرَةْ نَظْرَةْ يَاسِيدِي كِرْمَالْ عَلِي وَالزَّهْرَا
b: A glance, a glance, O my master, for the sake of Ali رضي الله عنه and Zahra

f: بَاللّه نَظْرَةْ يَا جَدَّاهْ كِرْمَالْ عَلِي وَالزَّهْرَا
b: By God, a glance, O grandfather, for the sake of Ali رضي الله عنه and Zahra

f: وَنَا لَمْدَحْ مُحَمَّدْ وَعَلِي يَا قُرِّةْ عَيْنِي
b: And I praise Muhammad and Ali رضي الله عنه, O delight of my eyes

f: بِاللّه نَظْرَةْ يَا سِيدِي يَا وَالِدَ السَّبْطَيْنِ
b: By God, a glance, O my master, O father of the two grandsons
My soul has yearned for the valley’s shore

f: فَهَا أَنَا ذَا رَبِّي خُذْ بِيَدِي
b: Here I am, my Lord, take me by the hand
I spend my nights calling aloud,
My heart melts away from sorrow’s fire
The Beloved struck me with overwhelming love,
And they said, “He has gone mad!” Oh, my endurance!
The love of Allah is a burning flame,
That consumes both soul and body.
An atom of love for the Merciful Lord
Removes all grief on the Day of Calling
I have fallen in love with the Divine, and I cannot be patient,
For the fire of His love burns within my heart
I love You, O Creator of all beings,
By Your truth, my Lord, You alone are my aim

f: لَكَ الحَمْدُ رَبِّي عَلَى كُلِّ حَالْ
b: All praise is Yours, my Lord, in every state,
For You are the One, without number or partner
O people of love, by Allah, you are
In sweet delight and bliss forevermore.

f: وَاللَّهِ مَا حُـولْ عَنْ حُـبِّ أَحْمَـدْ
b: By God, I will not turn away from the love of Ahmad,
Even if the swords of fate were to cut me down.
My cheek is a mat beneath your sandals,
Allow it, there's no harm in that.

f: مَا فِـي بِجَمَالَكْ فِـي الْكَوْنِ نَاسَ
b: No one in the universe matches your beauty,

f: يَا أَبَا الزَّهْرَةْ الْبَتُولْ نَظْرَةْ إِلَيْنَـا
b: O father of Zahra, the pure, glance upon us.

f: وَاللَّهِ مَا حُـولْ عَنْ حُـبِّ أَحْمَـدْ
b: By God, I will not turn away from the love of Ahmad,
Even if the swords of fate were to cut me down.
Nothing but your face heals my call,
An embrace from your chest erases my misery.
I was nearly ruined, have mercy on my tears
My soul for your sake, take it as a gift.

f: وَاللَّهِ مَا حُـولْ عَنْ حُـبِّ أَحْمَـدْ
b: By God, I will not turn away from the love of Ahmad,
Even if the swords of fate were to cut me down.
Visit me, even in a dream,

f: يَا أَبَا الزَّهْرَةْ الْبَتُولْ طَهَ التِّهَامِي
b: O father of Zahra, the pure, Taha the Tehami.
Your love, my master, stirred my passion,
It soared with the stars above the Pleiades.
If you mend my broken heart,
You are the ones who hold its reins and command
And if you arrive, O beloved ones,
Such is the way of the noble
The moons that shine through darkest nights have said:
“Tell the masters of passionate love
Whoever adores Muhammad,
Is in safety and in peace.”
The two seas of my tears have surged,
Nearly meeting as they flow
Between my hearing and my heart,
Is a barrier that does not transgress
And my Beloved, his two cheeks
Are twin roses, like bright red dye
And the tears that stream from my eyes,
Fall like the pouring of heavy rainclouds
The caravans set out, moving swiftly,
Seeking the land of Hijaz
And the mounts leap forward eagerly,
Trembling with longing and unrest
Whenever the guide calls them,
He who strives with sincerity succeeds
And love within my heart,
Shoots its arrows at every moment
Allah has sent to us,
His greatest sacred gift
Ahmad, the Chosen One, Ṭāhā,
Master of all the noble messengers

f: صِفْهُ لِي يَا مَنْ رَأَيْتَ الحِبَّ لَيْلاً
b: Describe him to me, O you who saw the Beloved in the night,
For my eyes long to behold that beauty
Describe one who is beautiful and perfect in creation and character

f: مِنْ جَمَالِ الذَّاتِ قَدْ حَازَ الكَمَالَا
b: From the essence of beauty, he has attained perfection
Describe a graceful one whose glance captivates worlds,
Describe a noble one whose face possesses perfection

f: صِفْهُ لِي يَا مَنْ رَأَيْتَ الحِبَّ لَيْلاً
b: Describe him to me, O you who saw the Beloved in the night,
For my eyes long to behold that beauty
Describe him to me in silken splendor when he appears,
Perfect in every trait, the very master of allure

f: صِفْ عُيُونَ الهَاشِمِي صِفْ لِي المُحْيَّا
b: Describe to me the eyes of the Hashimite—describe to me his radiance,
Describe to me a mouth whose smile radiated light

f: صِفْهُ لِي يَا مَنْ رَأَيْتَ الحِبَّ لَيْلاً
b: Describe him to me, O you who saw the Beloved in the night,
For my eyes long to behold that beauty

f: صِفْ جَمِيلاً أَكْحَلاً مِنْ غَيْرِ كُحْلٍ
b: Describe a beauty whose eyes are naturally dark-lined without kohl,
A deep-dark beautiful eyed one whose gaze makes you forget the gazelle
Describe the gentle-eyed, bright-faced one,
The wide-eyed, whose appearance makes you forget the crescent moon

f: صِفْهُ لِي يَا مَنْ رَأَيْتَ الحِبَّ لَيْلاً
b: Describe him to me, O you who saw the Beloved in the night,
For my eyes long to behold that beauty
Describe the elegance of his stature, the rose-tint of his cheeks,
Describe the handsome one whose beauty surpasses imagination
Describe his luminous neck like a shining star,

f: صِفْ جَمِيلاً نُورُهُ فِي الكَوْنِ لَالَا
b: Describe the beautiful one whose light in the universe gleams like pearls

f: صِفْهُ لِي يَا مَنْ رَأَيْتَ الحِبَّ لَيْلاً
b: Describe him to me, O you who saw the Beloved in the night,
For my eyes long to behold that beauty
Describe the brightness of his face, a radiant pearl,
Describe the king of beauty and recite to him longing’s song
Describe his arched brows, his shining white teeth,

f: صِفْ أَسِيلَ الخَدِّ صِفْ عَذْبَ المَقَالَا
b: Describe his smooth cheeks and his sweet, gentle speech

f: صِفْهُ لِي يَا مَنْ رَأَيْتَ الحِبَّ لَيْلاً
b: Describe him to me, O you who saw the Beloved in the night,
For my eyes long to behold that beauty
Describe his well-shaped mouth and sparkling incisors,

f: صِفْ نَدَى الرَّاحِ مِنْهُ الغَيْثُ سَالَا
b: Describe the dew of his palms from which the rain flowed forth

f: صِفْ طَوِيلَ الهُدْبِ صِفْ أَنْفاً كَسِيْفٍ
b: Describe his long lashes, describe a nose like a drawn sword,
Describe the arched brows meeting in perfect harmony

f: صِفْهُ لِي يَا مَنْ رَأَيْتَ الحِبَّ لَيْلاً
b: Describe him to me, O you who saw the Beloved in the night,
For my eyes long to behold that beauty

f: صِفْ نَبِيّاً قَدْ أَتَى مِنْ قَبْلِ آدَم
b: Describe a Prophet who came before Adam عليه السلام,

f: جَلَّ مَنْ سَوَّاهُ لَيْسَ لَهُ مِثَالَا
b: Exalted is the One who fashioned him—none resembles him
Did your eyes behold the visage of our Chosen One?
Tell me—by your Lord—how did you attain that union?

f: صِفْهُ لِي يَا مَنْ رَأَيْتَ الحِبَّ لَيْلاً
b: Describe him to me, O you who saw the Beloved in the night,
For my eyes long to behold that beauty

f: كَمْ أُنَادِي يَا أَبَا الزَّهْرَاءِ أَقْبِلْ
b: How often I call, “O Father of Zahra, come!”

f: كَمْ أُنَادِي يَا أَبَا الزَّهْرَا تَعَالَى
b: How often I call, “O Father of Zahra, draw near!”
I cried out: “Oh, how intense my longing, O my Beloved!”
For indeed, my eyes yearn for that beauty!
O Possessor of Majesty and Generosity,
O Possessor of Majesty and Generosity,
O Possessor of Majesty and Generosity,
Grant us to die upon the religion of Islam
O You who drew near and ascended,
And became pure in essence and family,
You rose to the highest heights,
In a journey that is unequaled
O Possessor of Majesty and Generosity,
O Possessor of Majesty and Generosity,
O Possessor of Majesty and Generosity,
Grant us to die upon the religion of Islam
Your chest was opened in completion,
And you were increased in knowledge and spiritual state,
You truly became an exemplary model,
You are Yāsīn and Ṭāhā
O Possessor of Majesty and Generosity,
O Possessor of Majesty and Generosity,
O Possessor of Majesty and Generosity,
Grant us to die upon the religion of Islam
For you, Al-Buraq showed reverence,
When it saw you, the beloved one,
It bowed its head, drawing near to you,
With your light, God manifested His splendor
O Possessor of Majesty and Generosity,
O Possessor of Majesty and Generosity,
O Possessor of Majesty and Generosity,
Grant us to die upon the religion of Islam
O you who were granted the Seven Oft-Repeated Verses (al-Fātiḥah)
And the key to the doors of meanings,
You ascended above the heavens,
And knocked upon its very gate
O Possessor of Majesty and Generosity,
O Possessor of Majesty and Generosity,
O Possessor of Majesty and Generosity,
Grant us to die upon the religion of Islam
You led the prophets in prayer,
In the sanctuary of the purified ones,
Then soared toward the heavens,
While the soul longed for its desire
O Possessor of Majesty and Generosity,
O Possessor of Majesty and Generosity,
O Possessor of Majesty and Generosity,
Grant us to die upon the religion of Islam
You met the People of the Message (Prophets),
The people of guidance and signification,
And you yourself were a radiant halo,
Rising in generosity and glory
O Possessor of Majesty and Generosity,
O Possessor of Majesty and Generosity,
O Possessor of Majesty and Generosity,
Grant us to die upon the religion of Islam
You were first given fifty prayers,
Then you were granted ease to make you pleased
Five remained as obligation and command,
And their supplicant’s call is answered
O Possessor of Majesty and Generosity,
O Possessor of Majesty and Generosity,
O Possessor of Majesty and Generosity,
Grant us to die upon the religion of Islam
And to end, may the blessing and peace
Of my Master - as long as birds coo
Upon the noble Prophet,
As long as the lover is enraptured in him
O Possessor of Majesty and Generosity,
O Possessor of Majesty and Generosity,
O Possessor of Majesty and Generosity,
Grant us to die upon the religion of Islam
And upon the Companions and the Family, the masters,
Leaders for mankind in goodness,
And upon the people of spiritual secrets and devotion,
Whose lives none can compare to.

f: لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللّٰه للّٰه اللّٰه
b: There is no God but Allah (Allah Allah)

f: لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللّٰه جُدْ عَلَيْنَا
b: There is no God but Allah, Bestow your Bounty on us!

f: إِنَّ فِي الْجَنَّةِ نَهْرًا مِنْ لَبَنْ
b: Indeed, in Paradise there is a river of milk
for ʿAlī, al-Ḥusayn, and al-Ḥasan
The love of the Prophet’s ﷺ family is an obligation upon us
And with this love, we fear no trials
Whoever is a lover of them
will enter Paradise without sorrow

f: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلَى الْمُخْتَارِ مِنْ مُضَرٍ
b: O my Lord, pour Your blessings upon the Chosen One of Muḍar
And the Prophets and all of the Messengers whenever they are mentioned
And pour blessings, O my Lord, upon the Guide and his Followers

f: وَصَحْبِهِ مَنْ لِطَيَّ الدِّينِ قَدْ نَشَرُوا
b: And his Companions, those who spread abroad the teachings of the religion
Who fought alongside him in the path of Allah, and struggled valiantly
ho emigrated, gave him shelter and aided him
Who made clear the farḍ and the sunna, joined forces
For the sake of Allah, clung to Allah and so were victorious
The most excellent, the most extensive, and the most noble of blessings,
Their fragrant diffusion sweetly permeates the universe
Fragrant with the odour of musk, delightful
From their scent spreads the sweet perfume of acceptance and good pleasure
In quantity as great as the pebbles, the moist earth, the grains of sand,
Followed by the stars in the heavens, Plants of the earth and mounds of clay
As great as the measure of the weight of the mountains,
And the drops of all the water and all the rain

f: وَعَدَّ مَا حَوَتِ الْأَشْجَارُ مِنْ وَرَقٍ
b: In number as great as the leaves of all the trees,
And every letter or character that will be read or written
In number as great as the wild animals, the birds, fish and cattle
Followed by the jinn, the angels and human beings

f: وَالذَّرُّ وَالنَّمْلُ مَعْ جَمْعِ الْحُبُوبِ كَذَا
b: The tiny motes and the ants, all the kernels of grain,
As well as hair and wool, feathers and animal fur

f: وَمَا أَحَاطَ بِهِ الْعِلْمُ الْمُحِيطُ وَمَا
b: And all that which comprises the total sum of knowledge,
And whatever was brought by the commanded Pen and the Divine Decree
In number as great as Your Favours,

f: على الْخَلَائِقِ مُذْ كَانُوا وَمُذْ حُشِرُوا
b: Which You have bestowed upon created beings, Ever since they came into being and were gathered together
As great as his lofty degree
By which the Prophets and the angels were ennobled, And they took pride in this

f: وَعَدَّ مَا كَانَ فِي الْأَكْوَانِ يَا سَنَدِي
b: As great as whatever exists in all the universes, O my Support,

f: وَمَا يَكُونُ إِلَى أَنْ تُبْعَثَ الصُّوَرُ
b: And whatever is still to come into existence, Until the Day when the forms will be resurrected

f: فِي كُلِّ طَرْفَةِ عَيْنٍ يَطْرِفُونَ بِهَا
b: In every twinkling of the eye by which
The people of the heavens and the earths Glance or cease to glance
Whatever fills the heavens and the earths,
Together with the mountains, the spread-out earth, The Throne, the Footstool and all they contain

f: مَا أَعْدَمَ اللّهُ مَوْجُوداً وَأَوْجَدَ مَعْــ
b: Whatever existing thing Allah has caused to vanish,
Or whatever non-existent thing He has brought into being Blessings without limit and enduring forever

f: تَسْتَغْرِقُ الْعَدَّ مَعْ جَمْعِ الدُّهُورِ كَمَا
b: Whose number lasts through all the ages, as

f: تُحِيطُ بِالْحَدِّ لَا تُبْقِي وَلَا تَذَرُ
b: They are boundless, leaving out nothing, encompassing all

f: لَا غَايَةً وَانْتِهَاءً يَا عَظِيمُ لَهَا
b: They have no final end and no conclusion, O Mighty One,
And no limit decreed, so consider this well

f: وَعَدَّ أَضْعَافِ مَا قَدْ مَرَّ مِنْ عَدَدٍ
b: In number as great as the multiples of all numbers there have been,

f: مَعْ ضِعْفِ أَضْعَافِهِ يَا مَنْ لَهُ الْقَدَرُ
b: Together with multiplying these multiples, O One Who decrees
Just as You love, O my Master, and in accordance with Your pleasure
And as You have commanded us to send blessings, You are the Owner of Mighty Power

f: مَعَ السَّلَامِ كَمَا قَدْ مَرَّ مِنْ عَدَدٍ
b: Together with peace, to the number of what has been mentioned
O my Lord, and multiply them both so that grace may spread far and wide
All of this further multiplied by Your Right in the breaths

f: أَنْفَاسِ خَلْقِكَ إِنْ قَلُّوا وَإِنْ كَثُرُوا
b: Of Your created beings, whether they be few in number or many
O my Lord, forgive the one who recites it,
As well as the one who hears it, And all of the Muslims, wherever they may be
And our parents, our families and our neighbours
For all of us, O my Master, are in great need of forgiveness

f: وَقَدْ أَتَيْتُ ذُنُوبًا لَا عِدَادَ لَهَا
b: I have committed many wrong actions - there is no end to them!

f: لَكِنَّ عَفْوُكَ لَا يُبْقِي وَلَا يَذَرُ
b: But indeed Your pardon leaves nothing - no sin remains

f: وَالْهَمُّ عَنْ كُلِّ مَا أَبْغِيهِ أَشْغَلَنِي
b: Worry has preoccupied me from all that I hope to attain,
And it came humbly and with a broken heart

f: أَرْجُوكَ يَا رَبِّ فِي الدَّارَيْنِ تَرْحَمُنَا
b: I beseech You, O my Lord, to show us mercy In the two worlds,

f: بِجَاهِ مَنْ فِي يَدَيْهِ سَبَّحَ الْحَجَرُ
b: by the rank of the one In whose hands pebbles glorified God

f: يَا رَبِّ أَعْظِمْ لَنَا أَجْرًا وَمَغْفِرَةً
b: O my Lord, increase for us both our reward and forgiveness,
For surely Your Generosity is a sea without a shore
Settle the debts which leave noble character in difficult straits,
And release us from our troubles, O You Who are Powerful

f: وَكُنْ لَطِيفًا بِنَا فِي كُلِّ نَازِلَةٍ
b: Be kind to us whenever calamities befall us,
With a beautiful kindness which causes all distress to disappear
By Mustafa, the Elected One, the Best of Creation,
In whose praise surahs were revealed to honour him

f: ثُمَّ الصَّلَاةُ عَلَى الْمُخْتَارِ مَا طَلَعَتْ
b: And then prayers be upon the Chosen One

f: شَمْسُ النَّهَارِ وَمَا قَدْ شَعْشَعَ الْقَمَرُ
b: As long as the sun shines upon the day, And the moon casts its radiance about

f: ثُمَّ الرِّضَا عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرٍ خَلِيفَتِهِ
b: And may You be pleased with Abu Bakr رضي الله عنه, his caliph,

f: مَنْ قَامَ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ لِلدِّينِ يَنْتَصِرُ
b: Who stood up for the religion after he was gone
And with Abu Hafṣ al-Fārūq, his companion

f: مَنْ قَوْلُهُ الْفَصْلُ فِي أَحْكَامِهِ عُمَرُ
b: ‘Umar رضي الله عنه, Whose word in his rulings was decisive

f: وَجُدْ لِعُثْمَانَ ذِي النُّورَيْنِ مَنْ كَمُلَتْ
b: And bestow good upon ‘Uthmān, he of the two lights, for whom
The virtues were perfected in the two worlds, and in the final victory
And likewise ‘Alī, as well as his two sons and their mother,

f: أَهْلُ الْعَبَاءِ كَمَا قَدْ جَاءَنَا الْخَبَرُ
b: The People of the Cloak, as has come down to us in tradition
And also our lady Khadijah al-Kubra رضي الله عنها who generously gave her wealth
In order to help and support the Messenger of Allah ﷺ
And those pure women, the wives of Mustafa,
And his daughters and sons, whenever they are mentioned

f: سَعْدٌ سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَوْفٍ طَلْحَةُ وَأَبُو
b: As well as Saʿd, Saʿīd ibn ʿAwf and Ṭalḥa
And Abu ʿUbayda رضي الله عنه and Zubayr, the finest of masters
And Hamza and also ‘Abbās, our master, and his son,

f: وَنَجْلُهُ الْحَبْرُ مَنْ زَالَتْ بِهِ الْغِيَرُ
b: The learned one through whom difficulties were resolved
And all the Family and Companions, and all the Followers,

f: مَا جَنَّ لَيْلُ الدَّيَاجِي أَوْ بَدَا السَّحَرُ
b: As long as darkness still falls upon the night, And the dawn reappears

f: مَعَ الرِّضَا مِنْكَ فِي عَفْوٍ وَعَافِيَةٍ
b: Bless them with good pleasure from You in pardon and well-being
And with a good ending when life draws to a close.
Be Enamored with the Beloved Muhammad ﷺ and His Noble Family
Being Enamored in His love pleases Him
Even if your body dies, love revives it
A body in which the love of Ahmad ﷺ has taken root
By Allah! the earth shall never consume it

f: طُوبَىٰ لِمَنْ هُوَ فِي المَحَبَّةِ صَبُّهُ
b: Glad tidings to him whose heart is consumed with love
For why not, when his Generous Lord loves him

f: فِي القَبْرِ حَاشَا أَنْ يُضَامَ مُحِبُّهُ
b: In the grave, never shall the lover be disgraced,
How could the soil ever consume him, when his love
Dwells in his heart and praise upon his lips
From being apart, my soul has grown weary,
I will not listen to the reproacher, even if he forbids me.
O lover of the Beloved’s essence and beauty,
Increase your prayers upon him, for indeed,
it is the illumination of your grave when you enter it

f: يَا رَبِّ عَبْدٌ قَدْ أَسَا بِفِعَالِهِ
b: O Lord! A servant who has erred in his deeds,
And in his humility, he has extended the palm of his plea,
He approaches Your Beloved, hoping for his grace,
A servant who seeks intercession through the Prophet ﷺ and his family
So by their right, O Lord, do not disgrace him.

f: يَا رَبَّنَا يَا مَوْلَانَا صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدْ مُصْطَفَى
b: O our Lord, our Master! Bless Muhammad, the Chosen One!

f: يَا رَبَّنَا يَا مَوْلَانَا صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدْ مُصْطَفَى
b: O our Lord, our Master! Bless Muhammad, the Chosen One!

f: يَا رَبَّنَا يَا مَوْلَانَا صَلِّ عَلَى الْمُصْطَفَى
b: O our Lord, our Master! Bless the Chosen One!

f: يَا رَبَّنَا يَا مَوْلَانَا صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدْ مُصْطَفَى
b: O our Lord, our Master! Bless Muhammad, the Chosen One!

f: هَلْ مِنْ مُغِيثٍ لِي مِمَّا فِي النَّفْسِ مِنْ حُزْنٍ وَمِنْ أَسَى
b: Can anyone save from the grief and remorse within my soul?

f: قَدْ وَلَّى الْعُمْرُ فِي السَّعْيِ الْحَرَامِ فِي الصُّبْحِ وَفِي الْمَسَا
b: My life is past, spent on forbidden things from morning to night.

f: فِي تَرْكِ الْأَوْلَى مَقْتُ الْمَوْلَى لِلْقَلْبِ الَّذِي قَسَى
b: Leaving what is right brings the Lord’s displeasure upon the hardened heart,

f: لٰكِنَّ الْبَارِي لِلْمُنَادِي مَنَّ نُوراً فِي الْقَلْبِ رَسَا
b: but the Creator blesses the petitioner with a light in the soul!

f: يَا رَبَّنَا يَا مَوْلَانَا صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدْ مُصْطَفَى
b: O our Lord, our Master! Bless Muhammad, the Chosen One!

f: يَا رَبَّنَا يَا مَوْلَانَا صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدْ مُصْطَفَى
b: O our Lord, our Master! Bless Muhammad, the Chosen One!

f: يَا رَبَّنَا يَا مَوْلَانَا صَلِّ عَلَى الْمُصْطَفَى
b: O our Lord, our Master! Bless the Chosen One!

f: يَا رَبَّنَا يَا مَوْلَانَا صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدْ مُصْطَفَى
b: O our Lord, our Master! Bless Muhammad, the Chosen One!

f: يَا كَاشِحَ الْمُحِبِّ كَمْ تَلُومُنِي عَلَى هٰذَا الْغَرَامْ
b: O denigrator of love, how you blame me for this burning passion!

f: وَالْعِشْقُ سِرُّ الْقَلْبِ لَا دَلِيلَ لَهُ إِلَّا الْمُسْتَهَامْ
b: But love is the heart’s secret, its only proof is infatuation

f: مَنْ ذَاقَ خَمْرَ الْعَاشِقِينَ ذَاقَ أَطْيَبَ الْمُدَامْ
b: Whoever tastes the lovers’ wine has tasted the sweetest drink!

f: هٰذَا صِرَاطِي مُسْتَقِيماً لَا يُنَالُ بِفَنِّ الْكَلَامْ
b: Such is my path, direct and ineffable, and cannot be attained with the art of words

f: يَا رَبَّنَا يَا مَوْلَانَا صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدْ مُصْطَفَى
b: O our Lord, our Master! Bless Muhammad, the Chosen One!

f: يَا رَبَّنَا يَا مَوْلَانَا صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدْ مُصْطَفَى
b: O our Lord, our Master! Bless Muhammad, the Chosen One!

f: يَا رَبَّنَا يَا مَوْلَانَا صَلِّ عَلَى الْمُصْطَفَى
b: O our Lord, our Master! Bless the Chosen One!

f: يَا رَبَّنَا يَا مَوْلَانَا صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدْ مُصْطَفَى
b: O our Lord, our Master! Bless Muhammad, the Chosen One!

f: سَرَى فِي لَيْلَةِ الْإِسْرَاءِ ظَاهِراً بِعَالَمِ الْخَفَا
b: On the Night of Isrā’ he ascended, physically, into the Unseen realm

f: دَنَا مِنْ رَبِّ الْعَرْشِ حَتَّى نَالَ مِنْ عَطَايَاهُ الْأَوْفَى
b: drawing near to the Lord of the Throne, and receiving His fullest gift.

f: مَا زَاغَتْ عَيْنُ الْمُصْطَفَى فَكَانَتْ عَهْداً وَوَفَا
b: The Chosen One’s eye swerved not; a covenant fulfilled.

f: هٰذَا النَّبِي أَدْرِكْ بِهِ نَوَالاً وَمَنَازِلَ الصَّفَا
b: This is the Prophet ﷺ! Attain through him grace and degrees of purity!

f: يَا رَبَّنَا يَا مَوْلَانَا صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدْ مُصْطَفَى
b: O our Lord, our Master! Bless Muhammad, the Chosen One!

f: يَا رَبَّنَا يَا مَوْلَانَا صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدْ مُصْطَفَى
b: O our Lord, our Master! Bless Muhammad, the Chosen One!

f: يَا رَبَّنَا يَا مَوْلَانَا صَلِّ عَلَى الْمُصْطَفَى
b: O our Lord, our Master! Bless the Chosen One!

f: يَا رَبَّنَا يَا مَوْلَانَا صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدْ مُصْطَفَى
b: O our Lord, our Master! Bless Muhammad, the Chosen One!

f: شَفِيعِي عِنْدَ هَوْلِ الْحَشْرِ رَافِعاً لِرَايَةِ الْآمَالْ
b: My intercessor on Judgement Day, lifting high the banner of hope

f: تَرَى الْبَرَايَا غُبْراً شُعْثاً خَوْفُهُمْ مِنْ رُؤْيَةِ الْأَعْمَالْ
b: Behold all mankind in dusty and in disorder, afraid to face their deeds

f: لَا غَوْثَ عِنْدَ ذَاكَ الْخَوْفِ حِينَ تَنْقَضِي الْآجَالْ
b: There will be no rescue from that dread, when all lives have been spent

f: إِلَّا بِمَنْ عَلَيْهِ مَنَّ الْمَوْلَى بِالْقَبُولِ وَالْكَمَالْ
b: but through him whom God blessed with acceptance and perfection.

f: الله الله الله الله الله الله يا مولانا
b: Allāh, Allāh, Allāh, Allāh, Allāh, Allāh — O our Master!

f: الله الله الله الله الله الله يا مولانا
b: Allāh, Allāh, Allāh, Allāh, Allāh, Allāh — O our Master!

f: رُفِعَتْ أَسْتَارُ البَيْنِ وَبَدَتْ أَنْوَارُ العَيْنِ
b: The curtains of 'between' have been lifted, and the lights of One-ness have appeared

f: تَنْجَلِي مِنْ غَيْرِ أَيْنِ فَاشْهَدُوهَا يَا صُوفِيَّةْ
b: Disclosed without any 'where', so see them, O Şüfis!

f: أَنَا مِرْآةُ حَبِيْبِي فِي هَوَاهُ رُوحِي طِيْبِي
b: I am the mirror of my Beloved, in His love, O my spirit, grow well

f: عَنْ سِوَاهُ نَفْسِي غِيْبِي وَاطْرَحِي الأَشْيَا الرَّدِيَّةْ
b: From other than Him, O self, be absent, and cast aside all things vile.

f: مُذْ بَدَا فِي ذِي المَشَاهِدْ صِرْتُ رَاكِعًا وَسَاجِدْ
b: Since He has manifested in these places of vision, have I been bowing and prostrate

f: شَاكِرًا لَهُ وَحَامِد إِذْ طَوَانِي فِي الهُوِيَّةْ
b: Thanking Him and praising, for He has encompassed me in identity.

f: يَا هَنَائِي فِي لِقَائِي يَا بَقَائِي فِي فَنَائِي
b: O wonderfulness of my encounter, O my subsistence in my annihilation

f: يَا ضِيَائِي فِي سَمَائِي يَا حَيَاتِي الأَبَدِيَّةْ
b: O the light of my empyrean, O my life forever and ever.

f: أَقْبَلَ السَّاقِي عَلَيْنَا قَدَّمَ الكَأْسَ إِلَيْنَا
b: The pourer has drawn near to us, and presented us the goblet.
We have sipped and drunk our fill, from the cups of al-Hashimi.

f: الـلَّهُ الـلَّـه يَـا الـلَّـه الـلَّـهُ الـلَّـه يَـا الـلَّـه
b: Allah Allah, O Allah, Allah Allah, O Allah

f: يَـا رَبِّ صَـلِّ عَـلَـى الـمُـخْـتَـارِ بَـدْرِ الـبُـدورْ
b: O Lord, send blessings upon the Chosen One, the full moon of moons

f: الـلَّـهُ يُـحَـقِّـقْ لَـنَـا لُـقْـيَـا الـنَّـبِـيِّ فِـي سُـرُورْ
b: May Allah grant us the joy of meeting the Prophet ﷺ

f: فِـي أُنْـسٍ كَـامِـلْ وَفِـي ذَوْقِ الـصَّـفَـا وَالـحُـبُـورِ
b: In complete harmony and the taste of purity and delight

f: الـلَّهُ الـلَّـه يَـا الـلَّـه الـلَّـهُ الـلَّـه يَـا الـلَّـه
b: Allah Allah, O Allah, Allah Allah, O Allah

f: يَـا رَبِّ صَـلِّ عَـلَـى الـمُـخْـتَـارِ بَـدْرِ الـبُـدورْ
b: O Lord, send blessings upon the Chosen One, the full moon of moons

f: يَـا رَبَّ الأَرْبَـابِ بِـالـمُـخْـتَـارْ طَـهَ الـشَّـكُـورْ
b: O Lord of lords, through the Chosen One, Taha the grateful

f: حَـبِـيـبِ قَـلْـبِـي الَّـذِي بِـهْ قَـدْ صَـلَـحْـنَ الأُمُـورْ
b: The beloved of my heart, through whom matters have been set right

f: الـلَّهُ الـلَّـه يَـا الـلَّـه الـلَّـهُ الـلَّـه يَـا الـلَّـه
b: Allah Allah, O Allah, Allah Allah, O Allah

f: يَـا رَبِّ صَـلِّ عَـلَـى الـمُـخْـتَـارِ بَـدْرِ الـبُـدورْ
b: O Lord, send blessings upon the Chosen One, the full moon of moons

f: صَـلِّ وَسَـلِّـمْ عَـلَـيْـهِ فِـي الـعَـشِـيْ والـبُـكُـورْ
b: Bless and grant peace upon him in the evening and the morning

f: وَآلِـهْ وَصَـحْـبِـهْ وَمَـنْ هُـمْ فِـي الـحَـضِـيـرَةْ حُـضُـورْ
b: And upon his family and companions and those present in the sacred gathering

f: الـلَّهُ الـلَّـه يَـا الـلَّـه الـلَّـهُ الـلَّـه يَـا الـلَّـه
b: Allah Allah, O Allah, Allah Allah, O Allah

f: يَـا رَبِّ صَـلِّ عَـلَـى الـمُـخْـتَـارِ بَـدْرِ الـبُـدورْ
b: O Lord, send blessings upon the Chosen One, the full moon of moons

f: وَاجْـعَـلْ لَـنَـا عِـنْـدَهُـمْ كَـاسَـاتْ حُـسْـنٍ تَـدُورْ
b: And grant us from them cups of beauty that revolve
Containing guidance, knowledge, and the pure drink

f: الـلَّهُ الـلَّـه يَـا الـلَّـه الـلَّـهُ الـلَّـه يَـا الـلَّـه
b: Allah Allah, O Allah, Allah Allah, O Allah

f: يَـا رَبِّ صَـلِّ عَـلَـى الـمُـخْـتَـارِ بَـدْرِ الـبُـدورْ
b: O Lord, send blessings upon the Chosen One, the full moon of moons

f: نَـذُوقُ أَذْوَاقٌ مَـا قَـطّ تَـنْـضَـبِـط فِـي الـسُّـطُـور
b: We taste flavors that cannot be confined to lines

f: وَمَـا هِـي إِلَّا مَـوَاهِـبْ لِاَهْـلِ طُـهْـرِ الـصُّـدُورْ
b: And they are but gifts for those with pure hearts

f: الـلَّهُ الـلَّـه يَـا الـلَّـه الـلَّـهُ الـلَّـه يَـا الـلَّـه
b: Allah Allah, O Allah, Allah Allah, O Allah

f: يَـا رَبِّ صَـلِّ عَـلَـى الـمُـخْـتَـارِ بَـدْرِ الـبُـدورْ
b: O Lord, send blessings upon the Chosen One, the full moon of moons
People chosen by the forgiving Lord of creation

f: بِـأسْـرَارِ حَـضْـرَتِـهْ لِـيْ مِـنْـهَـا الـدَّوَائِـرْ تَـدُورْ
b: With the secrets of His presence, from which circles revolve

f: الـلَّهُ الـلَّـه يَـا الـلَّـه الـلَّـهُ الـلَّـه يَـا الـلَّـه
b: Allah Allah, O Allah, Allah Allah, O Allah

f: يَـا رَبِّ صَـلِّ عَـلَـى الـمُـخْـتَـارِ بَـدْرِ الـبُـدورْ
b: O Lord, send blessings upon the Chosen One, the full moon of moons

f: وَلِـي بِـهَـا كُـلُّ أَمْـرِ الـبَـاطِـنَـةْ وَالـظُّـهُـورْ
b: And through it, all matters of the unseen and the manifest are mine
O brothers, the cups of knowledge and goodness have revolved

f: الـلَّهُ الـلَّـه يَـا الـلَّـه الـلَّـهُ الـلَّـه يَـا الـلَّـه
b: Allah Allah, O Allah, Allah Allah, O Allah

f: يَـا رَبِّ صَـلِّ عَـلَـى الـمُـخْـتَـارِ بَـدْرِ الـبُـدورْ
b: O Lord, send blessings upon the Chosen One, the full moon of moons

f: يَـا مَـنْ حَـضَـرْتُـمْ هُـنِـيـتُـمْ عِـنْـدَنَـا بِـالـحُـضُـورْ
b: O you who are present, you are blessed with presence among us

f: وَالـلَّـهُ يَـشْـرَحْ لَـكُـمْ بِـالـفَـضْـلِ كُـلِّ الـصُّـدُورْ
b: And may Allah open all hearts with grace for you

f: الـلَّهُ الـلَّـه يَـا الـلَّـه الـلَّـهُ الـلَّـه يَـا الـلَّـه
b: Allah Allah, O Allah, Allah Allah, O Allah

f: يَـا رَبِّ صَـلِّ عَـلَـى الـمُـخْـتَـارِ بَـدْرِ الـبُـدورْ
b: O Lord, send blessings upon the Chosen One, the full moon of moons

f: يَـارِبِّ كُـنْ عَـوْنَـهُـمْ هُـنَـا وَيَـوْمَ الـنُّـشُـورْ
b: O Lord, be their helper here and on the Day of Resurrection

f: وَكُـنْ نَـصِـيـراً لَـهُـمْ وَادْفَـعْ جَـمِـيْـعَ الـشُّـرُورْ
b: And be their supporter and repel all evils

f: الـلَّهُ الـلَّـه يَـا الـلَّـه الـلَّـهُ الـلَّـه يَـا الـلَّـه
b: Allah Allah, O Allah, Allah Allah, O Allah

f: يَـا رَبِّ صَـلِّ عَـلَـى الـمُـخْـتَـارِ بَـدْرِ الـبُـدورْ
b: O Lord, send blessings upon the Chosen One, the full moon of moons
And at the hour of conclusion, may Your grateful Chosen One be present
And Fatimah رضي الله عنها and Al-Rida and the noble lineage

f: الـلَّهُ الـلَّـه يَـا الـلَّـه الـلَّـهُ الـلَّـه يَـا الـلَّـه
b: Allah Allah, O Allah, Allah Allah, O Allah

f: يَـا رَبِّ صَـلِّ عَـلَـى الـمُـخْـتَـارِ بَـدْرِ الـبُـدورْ
b: O Lord, send blessings upon the Chosen One, the full moon of moons
Upon them be Your prayers in the evening and the morning
And all the companions and their followers until the Day of Resurrection

f: يَا أيُّهَا المُخْتَارُ مِنْ خَيْرِ الوَرَى
b: O you, the chosen one from the best of creation,
In character and form, uniquely perfect,
What can I say in his praise,

f: وَاللهُ طَهَّرَ مِنْ سِفَاحِ الجَاهِلِيَّةِ أَحْمَدَا
b: When God purified Ahmad from the ignorance of the past,
Full of compassion for the believers and mercy,
Your Lord named you in the Quran as Muhammad,
The noble messengers called upon you and gave glad tidings,
And the angels of the Merciful prostrated behind you,

f: لَا يُحْصِي فَضْلَكَ نَاثِرٌ أوْ كَاتِبٌ عَدَداً
b: No writer or poet can count your virtues,
O refuge of generosity,
May God's prayers be upon you eternally,

f: ثُمَّ السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا نَجْمَ الهُدَى
b: And peace be upon you, O star of guidance.
How can I sleep at night, how can I rest?
My beloved Muhammad, his words are jewels

f: سَفِّنْ بِاللَّه يَا سَفَّانْ دِيرِ السَّفِينَة
b: Sail in God's name, O sailor, steer the ship
The lights of Abu al-Qasim have shone upon us.
Accompany the Arabs and drink their milk
All the companions are stars, Taha is their moon.

f: ‎يَا طَيْرَ الطَّايِرْ فُوقْ أَبْيَضْ يَا بُو جْنَاح
b: O flying bird above, white-winged one,

f: ‎سَلِّمْ عَلَى أبى الزهراء قُلُّهْ العُمُرْ رَاح
b: Greet the father of Zahra and tell him the minds have gone.

f: ‎يَا طَيْرَ الطَّايِرْ فُوقْ أَخْضَرْ يَا بُـو رِيشْ
b: O flying bird above, green-feathered one,
Greet Ṭāhā and tell him we've become dervishes

f: مَا رِيدَ اَمُوتَ الْيَوْمْ كَفْنِي عَبَاتِي
b: I do not wish to die today, my cloak is my only shroud
Send to Ṭāhā so he may attend my death
O, how felicitous are a people who attained Allah!
And saw nothing in existence except Him!
He drew them near to Him and chose them
So their minds declared Him to be free from every imperfection
They have no inclination to anything other than Him
How could they when they have witnessed His exaltedness?!
He removed the veil of His covering from them
So they inhaled a whiff of His love!
He manifested light and splendor

f: لَهُمْ فَقَالُوا يَا هُوَ يَا هُو
b: to them, so they said, "O He Who is! O He Who is!"
So He said to them, "I am your Lover!"
What a generous Lord! What a wonderful God!
I accept those who repent from among My slaves
And I do not care what they have done!
The Kingdom is My Kingdom! And the Command is My Command!
And the Might is My Might! So enter His sanctuary!
None knows the taste of passion except
Those who know union!
Never did I say to my heart, "Who is my beloved?"
Except that it said, "Allah!"
Whenever I remember my Lord,
I tremble in longing to meet Him!
I roam alone in my true ecstasy;
and my beautiful endeavour is that I may perhaps see Him!
So look at the universe with reflection
Within the earth of your Master and His heavens!
And listen when praises of Him are sung
Say, "O He Who is! I'm at your service, Allah!"
Then, blessings be upon the Messenger ﷺ!
Muhammad ﷺ, whom our Lord chose!
Recount to use the days of our loved ones
O you who captivate the hearts
And relate a tale about them that is sweet
And drive away our pains through them
With them my life has become pure
And their love is a cure for my ailment
Their bond surrounds me in all my days
Countless the blessings upon those who seek them
O our Lord, send everlasting prayers
Upon the Prophet ﷺ Ṭāhā Ahmad
Whenever a bird appears or sings
And upon his family and his companions
The gaze of the lover upon the beloved is peace,
And silence among the knowers is speech.
They gathered the expression through the indication between them,
And by it their understandings were in agreement
They converse with their glances, not their words,

f: فَلَذَا بِمَا فِي نَفْسِ ذَا إِلْهَامُ
b: Thus, what is in one's soul is inspiration.

f: هَذَا هُنَاكَ وَذَا هُنَاكَ إِذَا تَرَى
b: This one is there, and that one is here when you see,
And the secret of this is with the secret of that.
Their secrets meet, embrace, and intertwine,
While their bodies part ways.

f: فَيَقُولُ ذَا عَنْ ذَا وَذَا عَنْ ذَا بِمَا
b: This one speaks of that, and that of this,
What is conveyed to them, the pens write.
Disagreement fell away and its wording from their speech,
For they are enamored with the letters of harmony.
They became accustomed to saying “Yes, at Your service” and united thereby,

f: إِذْ لَا وَلَيْسَ عَلَى الكِرامِ حَرَامُ
b: For “No” is forbidden upon the noble.
Their customs are like those of the people of Paradise, their character
Is Prophetic; they are godly and noble.
Their desires, selves, and fortunes are behind,
And the deeds of the righteous are ahead.
For them, hands are extended with generosity,
And their feet stood firm in fulfilling what was due.
Thus, the journey is knowledge, and intellects are guides,
The Lord is the aim, and the Messenger ﷺ is the leader.

f: فِيَّ حُبٌّ فِيَّ وَجدٌ واشتياقٌ لا يُحَدُّ
b: Within me is burning love, within is rapturing longing unknown to limits

f: يا رَسولَ اللهِ قَلبِي لم يَزَلْ بِاسْمِكَ يَشْدُو
b: O Messenger of Allah ﷺ! My heart has never seized to sing your name

f: أَنتَ لِلعَالَمِ رَحْمة جِئتَ تَمْحُو كُلَّ ظُلمَة
b: You are mercy to the worlds, sent to obliterate every darkness,

f: نَحْنُ يا خَيْرَ رَسولٍ بِكَ صِرْناَ خَيرَ أُمّة
b: O Best of Messengers! Because of You, we became the Best Community

f: فِيَّ حُبٌّ فِيَّ وَجدٌ واشتياقٌ لا يُحَدُّ
b: Within me is burning love, within is rapturing longing unknown to limits

f: يا رَسولَ اللهِ قَلبِي لم يَزَلْ بِاسْمِكَ يَشْدُو
b: O Messenger of Allah ﷺ! My heart has never seized to sing your name

f: حُبُّكَ السَاكِنُ فِيَّ لَمْ يَزَلْ يَهْمِي عَلَيَّ
b: Your Love has settled within me, it continues to gently pour upon me

f: بَهْجَةً فِي الرُّوحِ فَاضَتْ وَسَلاماً اَبَدِيَّ
b: Ecstasy and Everlasting Peace has filled my soul!

f: فِيَّ حُبٌّ فِيَّ وَجدٌ واشتياقٌ لا يُحَدُّ
b: Within me is burning love, within is rapturing longing unknown to limits

f: يا رَسولَ اللهِ قَلبِي لم يَزَلْ بِاسْمِكَ يَشْدُو
b: O Messenger of Allah ﷺ! My heart has never seized to sing your name

f: صَلِ يَا رَبِّ عَلَيْهِ وَاسْقِنَا مِنْ رَاحَتَيهِ
b: Send Benedictions Upon Him O My Master, give us drink from His Blessed Palms

f: ذَابَتِ الرُّوحُ وَتَاقَت وَبَكَتْ شَوقًا إِلَيْهِ
b: The Soul Melts and repents, and Weeps in Yearning for Him!

f: فِيَّ حُبٌّ فِيَّ وَجدٌ واشتياقٌ لا يُحَدُّ
b: Within me is burning love, within is rapturing longing unknown to limits

f: يا رَسولَ اللهِ قَلبِي لم يَزَلْ بِاسْمِكَ يَشْدُو
b: O Messenger of Allah ﷺ! My heart has never seized to sing your name

f: مُذ دَعَا بِالنُّورِ دَاعٍ رَدَّدَتْ كُلُّ البِقَاعِ
b: Ever Since the Caller called out with his Blessed Light, Every plot of land responded

f: طَلَعَ البَدْرُ عَلَيْنَا مِنْ ثَنِيَّاتِ الوَدَاعِ
b: The Luminous full moon has risen upon us from the blessed Valley of Wadaa
Glad tidings to us, we have attained our wish
Hardship has vanished, and joy has arrived
By Allah, His promise has been fulfilled
And the good news has become openly declared
O my soul, rejoice in the meeting
O eyes, be comforted, our eyes are blessed
This is the beauty of the Chosen One
His lights have shone upon us
Glad tidings to us, we have attained our wish
Hardship has vanished, and joy has arrived
By Allah, His promise has been fulfilled
And the good news has become openly declared
O Taybah, what shall we say
And in you, the Messenger ﷺ has settled
And all of us long to reach
To Muhammad, our Prophet ﷺ
Glad tidings to us, we have attained our wish
Hardship has vanished, and joy has arrived
By Allah, His promise has been fulfilled
And the good news has become openly declared
O garden of the guiding intercessor
And his two companions and those in Al-Baqi
Write for all of us
A visit to our Prophet
Glad tidings to us, we have attained our wish
Hardship has vanished, and joy has arrived
By Allah, His promise has been fulfilled
And the good news has become openly declared
Where wishes bloom like a garden
And the sweetness of what is gathered endures.
And with the beloved, Chosen One
Our lives become pure and pleasant
Glad tidings to us, we have attained our wish
Hardship has vanished, and joy has arrived
By Allah, His promise has been fulfilled
And the good news has become openly declared
Send blessings and peace, O Source of Peace
Upon the Prophet ﷺ, the full moon of perfection
And upon his noble family and honored companions
May our Lord send blessings upon them
Send my peace, O traveler to the Sacred Sanctuary
Pray for me, and greet the guide of all nations
Look at the Ka‘bah, how beautiful it is
Light and majesty envelope it
My Lord protects it and watches over it
Mention me before it, and pray for me
And pray for me!

f: يَـا سَـاعِـي بـهِـمَّـةْ مِـن الـصَّـفَـا لِـلْـمَـرْوَة
b: O you who strive with resolve from Safa to Marwah

f: يَـا شَـارِبْ مِـنْ زَمْـزَمْ اتـذَكَّـرْنِـي بِـدَعْـوَة
b: O you who drink from Zamzam, remember me with a supplication
O you ascending the Mount of Mercy
O you walking in the midst of the crowd
Ask your Lord for mercy
And mention me there, and pray for me
And pray for me!
Send my peace, O traveler to the Sacred Sanctuary
Pray for me, and greet the guide of all nations
Look at the Ka‘bah, how beautiful it is
Light and majesty envelope it
My Lord protects it and watches over it
Mention me before it, and pray for me
And pray for me!
Glad tidings to you, O traveler heading to the Guide — the Prophet ﷺ
His love has preoccupied me, it fills my whole heart

f: اُدْخُـلْ مِـنْ بَـابِ الـسَّـلَامِ بِـتَـأَدُّبٍ وَاحْـتِـرَامٍ
b: Enter through Bāb al-Salām — the Prophet’s ﷺ gate of visitation — with humility and reverence
Greet Ṭāhā of Tihāmah, the pure one
Ask him for intercession, and pray for me
And pray for me!
My Beloved, O Messenger of Allah ﷺ
My healer, O Messenger of Allah ﷺ
Muhammad ﷺ, The Light of the Throne of Allah
My Beloved, The Best of Allah's creation
To Taybah (Medina), the caravans have set forth,
To Taybah (Medina), my heart, mad with longing, races
To Taybah, for the Prophet ﷺ—descendant of Adnan,
It's resident is The Beloved Messenger of Allah ﷺ
My Beloved, O Messenger of Allah ﷺ
My healer, O Messenger of Allah ﷺ
Muhammad ﷺ, The Light of the Throne of Allah
My Beloved, The Best of Allah's creation
My very Life is from connection to You
My death is from seperation from You
May my soul be your ransomed for You
Intercession!! O Messenger of Allah ﷺ!
My Beloved, O Messenger of Allah ﷺ
My healer, O Messenger of Allah ﷺ
Muhammad ﷺ, The Light of the Throne of Allah
My Beloved, The Best of Allah's creation
My heart yearns for The Prophet ﷺ (with burning Love)
And in my soul, the ache of longing is stirred
My only desire: to cling to the Blessed Enclosure (of The Prophet ﷺ)
and Call out: "O Beloved of Allah!!"
My Beloved, O Messenger of Allah ﷺ
My healer, O Messenger of Allah ﷺ
Muhammad ﷺ, The Light of the Throne of Allah
My Beloved, The Best of Allah's creation
O My Beloved--O Father of Zahra (Sayyida Fatima رضي الله عنها)
O My Healer--We long for a Glance from you
O Muhammad!! O Father of Zahra
I plead for your protection--O Messenger of Allah ﷺ!!
My Beloved, O Messenger of Allah ﷺ
My healer, O Messenger of Allah ﷺ
Muhammad ﷺ, The Light of the Throne of Allah
My Beloved, The Best of Allah's creation
O Muhammad--O Father of Qasim
O my Healer! I am enraptured (in love)
Muhammad--Love of you is my necessity
Intercession!! O Messenger of Allah ﷺ!!
Ahmad, O my beloved
O aid of the stranger
Peace be upon you
Peace be upon you
A sanctuary of peace and safety
Peace be upon you
Your religion is Islam
Peace be upon you
From a merciful Lord
Peace be upon you
From a generous Lord
Peace be upon you
You came with the Quran
Peace be upon you
From the All Merciful
Peace be upon you
You came with monotheism
Peace be upon you
You triumphed with glory
Peace be upon you
And we gained goodness
Peace be upon you
In Mina and Arafat
Peace be upon you
And erased the sins
Peace be upon you
By stoning the pillars
Peace be upon you
Be content with a small portion [of this world],
and ready your provisions for the long journey [to the Hereafter]
Don’t be deceived by this world — let go of it,
for this world isn’t a home for [its] guest.
And don’t think you’ll remain [in this world],
for there is no path to permanence [in it].
Be content with a small portion [of this world],
and ready your provisions for the long journey [to the Hereafter]
And don’t worry about wealth left behind,
it’ll be passed to your close relative or descendant.
So provide through it, no matter how much it is,
such that it goes ahead to the Weighty Day.
Be content with a small portion [of this world],
and ready your provisions for the long journey [to the Hereafter]
And the best of provision is taqwa — know this,
so strive, and avoid idle talk.
And the right of Allah is the greatest of all rights,
so stand by the truth for the King of Majesty.
Be content with a small portion [of this world],
and ready your provisions for the long journey [to the Hereafter]
Obeying him is the enriching to both worlds, so cling to it,
and in that is honor for the lowly servant.
And in disobeying Him is shame and the Fire,
and in that is distance from Him with terrible disgrace.
Be content with a small portion [of this world],
and ready your provisions for the long journey [to the Hereafter]
so don’t disobey Him, rather, obey Him,
constantly, so you may be granted acceptance,
and the pleasure of a Merciful Lord,
immense in His bounty, the Giver of Great Gifts.
Be content with a small portion [of this world],
and ready your provisions for the long journey [to the Hereafter]
And our Lord sends blessings in every moment,
and peace, morning and evening,
on Taha ﷺ, the caller to every good,
and the Seal of Prophets, and the Guiding Leader.
My heart longs for you
My Lord prays upon you
How can I not love you
When beauty belongs to you
You are the adornment of mankind
You perfume the air with every breath
The gathering rejoices
By the praises sung in your presence
My heart longs for you
My Lord prays upon you
How can I not love you
When beauty belongs to you
O guide of the confused
Throughout the ages
Mankind and jinn seek refuge
In the hereafter with you
My heart longs for you
My Lord prays upon you
How can I not love you
When beauty belongs to you
You, O chosen one
Gatherer of secrets
The attendees ascend
By sending prayers upon you
My heart longs for you
My Lord prays upon you
How can I not love you
When beauty belongs to you
O great in stature
Say that I am safe
I ask the Merciful
To send prayers upon you
Allah, O Allah, O Allah
Allah, O Allah, O Allah

f: يا رَبِّ إِنْ عَظُمَتْ ذُنُوبِيَ كَثْرَةً
b: O Lord, if my sins have grown in number
I know that Your forgiveness is greater

f: يَا رَبِّ عَبْدُكَ قَدْ أَتَاكَ بِبَابِهِ
b: O Lord, Your servant has come to Your door
Humbled, who else but Your pardon shows mercy?
Far be it from You to turn away one who calls upon You
Hoping for satisfaction, shedding tears that break

f: إِنْ لَمْ أَكُنْ أَهْلًا لِفَضْلِكَ وَاحِدًا
b: If I am not worthy of Your grace, O One
Then pardon is Your way, every sin You forgive, however great
Bestow upon me an accepted repentance

f: يَا خَيْرَ مَنْ يُرْجَى وَمَنْ يَتَرَحَّمُ
b: O best of those who are hoped for and who show mercy
Forgive a heart that has come imploring
The grace of the Generous, and every sin I bear
Wash away my sins that have burdened me
And mend a heart shattered by calamities
Make my end at death a glad tiding
Honor me on a day with light that dignifies
Shade me on the Day of Resurrection with contentment
And unite me with the Chosen One, the honored
And send, my Lord, always Your prayers and peace
Upon the Prophet ﷺ, his family, and as it concludes

f: وَاجْعَلْ لَنَا فِي كُلِّ دَرْبٍ رَاحَةً
b: Grant us comfort on every path
Guide hearts to the light of truth that rules
And send, my Lord, always Your prayers and peace
Upon the Prophet ﷺ, his family, as we conclude
I called upon You, my Lord, as the world burdened me

f: فَأَنتَ أَعْلَمُ مَا أَلقَاهُ مَا فِيهَا
b: For You know best what I endure within it
Wipe away a tear I do not even understand
For only to You do I complain of the sorrow I conceal
Write for my soul a joy that never departs
And grant my heart peace within all its hopes

f: وَامْنُنْ عَلَيَّ بِعَفْوٍ لَا انْقِطَاعَ لَهُ
b: Bestow upon me a pardon that never ends
One that heals wounds and revives the soul of its Maker

f: فِي لَيْلَةِ القَدْرِ فَاضَ النُّورُ مُنْسَكِبًا
b: On Laylatul Qadr, when light pours abundantly
Accept my prayers and be the guide of my soul
Forgive a heart that comes to You broken and in love
Hoping for Your pleasure, shedding tears as it pleads
Grant me freedom (from the Fire) as I supplicate in this world
And on the Day of Resurrection, make it my eternal gift
Clothe my soul in garments of guidance through Your grace
For light flows wherever the Most Merciful guides it

f: وَاخْتِمْ لِيَ العُمْرَ فِي خَيْرٍ وَمَغْفِرَةٍ
b: Let my life end in goodness and forgiveness
And place me among the righteous to drink from Your mercy
Allow my soul to enter Your paradise in devotion
For Jannah is light, where gentle breezes tell its beauty
Oh Allah, send Your blessings upon the Chosen One, our Master
Tāhā, the intercessor, bless and elevate his noble ranks
Ramadan appears, splendid and smiling
Blessed is the servant who reaps its benefits!
He will please his Master by observing [acts of worship]
Blessed be the soul for its taqwa!
Ramadan is a time for good deeds
Ramadan is a time of blessings
Ramadan is an occasion for prayers
By which the soul rises to its Lord
Ramadan appears, splendid and smiling
Blessed is the servant who reaps its benefits!
He will please his Master by observing [acts of worship]
Blessed be the soul for its taqwa!
Ramadan is a time for purifying the soul
Ramadan is a time of joy
Ramadan is the guide to put things right
In this life and the life to come
Ramadan appears, splendid and smiling
Blessed is the servant who reaps its benefits!
He will please his Master by observing [acts of worship]
Blessed be the soul for its taqwa!
Ramadan amends the shortcomings
Of people, and their mistakes
May Allah by His Forgiveness
Fill the hearts of the Umma with His caring love

f: الله الله يا الله الله الله يا الله الله الله يا الله
b: Allah, Allah, O Allah, Allah, Allah, O Allah, Allah, Allah, O Allah

f: يا رِبِّ صَلِّ علَى طَه الرَّؤوفِ الرَّحيْم
b: O Lord, bless Taha, the compassionate, the merciful

f: رَمَضَانُ شَهْرُ التَّجَلِّي مِنْ إلَهيَ الْكَرِيمِ
b: Ramadan is the month of manifestation from my generous God

f: رَمَضَانُ فِيهِ الْعَطَا مِنْ فَضْلِ رَبِّي عَظِيمْ
b: Ramadan, in it is the giving from the bounty of my great Lord

f: رَمَضَانُ فِيهِ الْكَرَمْ مِنْ خَيْرِ وَاهِبْ كَرِيمْ
b: Ramadan, in it is the generosity from the best generous giver

f: كَمْ مِنْ مِنَحْ كَمْ عَطَايَا مَا تُقَوَّمْ بِقِيمْ
b: How many gifts, how many bounties, cannot be valued

f: وَكَمْ مِنْ أَسْرَارْ فِيهَا كُلُّ لُبٍّ يَهِيمْ
b: And how many secrets in it, every heart is passionate

f: ألبَابُ أَهْلِ الْهُدَى مِنْ كُلِّ عَارِفْ حَلِيمْ
b: The hearts of the people of guidance from every knowledgeable patient

f: رَحَماتٌ صُبَّتْ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنْ إِلَهٍ رَحِيمٍ
b: Mercies poured upon them from a merciful God

f: فَالكُلُّ أَمْسَى لِحِبِّهْ فِي المَحَاضِر نَدِيمْ
b: So everyone became fond of him in the presence of the generous
The cup is circulating and their pourer is his generous gift

f: يَا مَنْ لَهُ قَلْبٌ رَاغِبْ فِي المَعَالِي سَلِيمْ
b: O who has a heart desiring the high, pure

f: إِسْمَعْ كَلَامِي وَكُنْ لِلْرَّمْزِ يَاذَا فَهِيمْ
b: Listen to my words and be for the symbol, O understanding

f: فَهْيَ دَلَالَاتٌ مِنْ نُورِ الصِّرَاطِ القَوِيمْ
b: They are indications from the light of the straight path

f: بِهَا عَلِمْ كُلُّ عَارِفْ فِي البَرَايا عَلِيمْ
b: With it, every knowledgeable person in the creation is learned

f: سُقُّوا كُؤوسِ التَّجَلِي مِن خِطَابِ الكَلِيمْ
b: They were given cups of manifestation from the speech of the Speaker

f: وَوَاجَهَتْهُمْ مِنَحْ مَا تَحْتَصِي جِيْم مِيمْ
b: And they faced gifts that cannot be comprehended

f: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ خَصَّهُمْ ذُو الجُودِ أَكْرَم كَرِيمْ
b: Glory to the one who singled them out, the most generous of the generous
They strive in secret, preparing for the lasting bliss

f: نَسْلُكْ صِرَاطِ النَّبِيْ خَيْرِ الوَرَى المُسْتَقِيمْ
b: We follow the path of the Prophet ﷺ, the best of creation, the upright

f: مَنْ قَدْ وَصَفَهُ المُهَيْمِنْ بِالرَّؤُوفِ الرَّحِيمْ
b: Who has been described by the Guardian as compassionate, merciful

f: عَسَى عَسَى فِيْ حِمَاهُ الزَّيْنْ يا اخْوَةْ نُقِيمْ
b: Perhaps, perhaps in his sanctuary, O brothers, we will reside

f: هُوْ سِرُّ سِرِّي وَرُوحِي وَهُوَ ذُخْرِي العَظِيمْ
b: He is the secret of my secret and my spirit, and he is my great treasure

f: عَلَيْهِ صَلَّى إِلَهِي عَدَّ هَبِّ النَّسِيمْ
b: Upon him, my God has blessed the number of the breeze

f: عَلَيْهِ صَلَّى إِلَهِي عَدَّ هَبِّ النَّسِيمْ
b: Upon him, my God has blessed the number of the breeze

f: وَاَلِهْ خُصُوصِ ابْنَتُهْ أَلذُّخْرِ كَنْزِ العَدِيمْ
b: And his family, especially his daughter, the most precious treasure
So her remembrance, O congregation, is the cure for the sick

f: لَهَا مَرَاتِبْ لَدَى المَوَلى وَقَدْرٌ عَظِيمْ
b: She has ranks with the Master and a great status

f: وَصَحْبِهِ الكُلُّ أَهْلُ الصِّدْقِ حَتْفِ الرَّجِيمْ
b: And all his companions, the people of truth, a sword against the rejected
And those who followed them with excellence, with a pure heart.

f: صَلُّوا عَلَى النُّورِ الَّذِي عَرَجَ السَّمَا
b: Pray upon the light that ascended the sky

f: يَا فَوْزَ مَن صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ وَ سَلَّمَا
b: Oh, the fortune of those who pray upon him and send peace
Suleima bestowed union graciously

f: فَسَرَى السُّرُورُ إلَى الفُؤَادِ وَ خَيَّمَا
b: Joy spread to the heart and settled therein

f: يَا حُسْنَ مَا جَادَتْ بِهِ فِي وَصْلِهَا
b: Oh, the beauty of what she granted in her union
Welcome to a union where I gained the prize
Gifts that minds hasten to attain
And blessings of grace that bestowed upon us abundance

f: يَا حَادِيَ العِيسِ الرَّوَاسِمِ عُجْ بِهَا
b: Oh, camel driver of the marked camels, stop with them

f: سَفْحَ العَقِيقِ وَ حُطَّ رَحْلَكَ فِي الحِمَى
b: At the foot of Al-Aqiq and set your camp in the sanctuary

f: فِي مَـنْـزِلِ الجُودِ الغَـزِيرِ وَ مَنْبَعِ
b: In the abode of abundant generosity and the source of

f: الفَضْلِ الكَبِيرِ وَ خَيْرِ مَجْدٍ قَدْ نَمَا
b: Great virtue and the best of glory that has grown

f: فِي جَنَّةٍ مَا شَاقَنِي مِنْ وَصْفِهَا
b: In a paradise, what has enchanted me from its description
Except for the presence of the beloved who resides there
When shall I see it, kissing its soil
Oh, how I wish to kiss that soil
Gentle with a heart attached in love
With aspirations hoping to be honored
When the homes of my masters are mentioned

f: كَادَتْ دُمُوعُ العَيْنِ أَنْ تَجْرِي دَمَا
b: The tears of my eyes almost flow as blood
Or when my eyes behold their near abode
I find myself consecrated among those who are consecrated

f: قَسَمَاً بِرَبِّ الْبَيْتِ مَا ذُكِرَ النَّقَى
b: I swear by the Lord of the House, whenever the pure is mentioned

f: وَ المُنْحَنَى إلَّا وَ كُنْتُ مُـتَـيَمَّا
b: And the graceful, I am always enamored

f: يَا لَيْلَةً بَاتَ الحَبِيبُ يُدِيرُ مِنْ
b: Oh, a night when the beloved served from
The cup of union, a drink so delightful
My longing for the abode of the beloved Muhammad ﷺ

f: شَوْقٌ تَمَكَّنَ فِي الْحَشَا وَ تَكَتَّمَا
b: A longing that has settled in the heart and remained hidden
A dwelling that contained all of God's blessings

f: مُذْ حَلَّ فِيهَا خَيْرُ عَبْدٍ قَدْ سَمَا
b: Since the best of servants, who has ascended, settled there

f: الله الله يَا الله الله الله يَا الله
b: Allah Allah O Allah! Allah Allah O Allah!

f: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلَى المُخْتَارِ طِبِّ القُلُوبْ
b: O Lord bestow your peace and blessings upon the chosen one, healer of hearts

f: يَا رَبِّ فَرِّجْ عَلَى الأُمَّةْ جَمِيعَ الكُرُوبْ
b: O Lord alleviate all distresses from the Ummah

f: يَا رَبَّنَا ادْفَعْ جَمِيعَ الاِبْتِلَا وَالخُطُوبْ
b: O Lord alleviate all afflictions and calamities

f: يَا رَبَّنَا ارْفَعْ جَمِيعَ اللَّقْلَقَةْ وَالشُّغُوبْ
b: O Lord remove all hesitancies and troubles

f: يَارَبِّ هَبْنَا عَطَا وَاسِعْ مَدَى الدَّهْرِ دُوبْ
b: O Lord gift us vast gifts as long as time continues

f: جُدْ وَاجْمَعِ الشَّمْلَ يَا مَوْلَايَ فُكَّ العَصُوبْ
b: Grant us your grace and unite us O Master and release the tensions

f: نَعِيشُ عِيشَةْ صَفَا عَنْ كُلِّ كُدْرَةْ وَشُوبْ
b: So we may live a life of purity from all taints and contaminations

f: فِي زُمْرَةْ أَهْلِ الوَفَا فِي خَيْرِ كُلِّ الحُزُوبْ
b: In the company of the faithful ones who are the best of all groups

f: سَارُوا عَلَى دَرْبِ نُورِ القَلْبِ خَيْرَ الدُّرُوبْ
b: Those who traversed the path of the heart’s light, the best of all paths
Muhammad the chosen one, the selected one, the healer of hearts

f: يَارَبِّ حَقِّقْ رَجَانَا وَاكْفِ أَهْلَ الشُّغُوبْ
b: O Lord fulfil our hopes and ward us from those who sow discord

f: تُمْطِرْ سَحَائِبْ بِسَيْلِ الفَضْلِ يُمْلِي الجُرُوبْ
b: So the clouds pour down flooding grace which fills the vessels

f: كُلٌّ يُسَقِّي بِذَاكَ السَّيْلِ يَحْصُدْ حُبُوبْ
b: All drink from that flood harvesting abundant loved

f: بِرِزْقٍ وَاسِعٍ وَلَا يَنْفَدْ مَدَى الدَّهْرِ دُوبْ
b: With abundant provisions that never runs dry throughout all time

f: يَا غَافِرَ الذَّنْبِ اغْفِرْ رَبَّنَا ذِي الذُّنُوبْ
b: O Forgiver of sins forgive our Lord our sins

f: يَا غَافِرَ الذَّنْبِ اغْفِرْ رَبَّنَا ذِي الذُّنُوبْ
b: O Forgiver of sins forgive our Lord our sins

f: وَجَمِّلِ الحَالَ وَاسْتُرْ رَبِّ كُلَّ العُيُوبْ
b: And beautify our state and conceal O Lord every flaw
By virtue of the blessings of the chosen one, the selected one, the highest of that which is sought
And his family, companions, and those who follow them along the best of paths

f: بِـكَ قَـدْ صَـفَتْ مِـنْ دَهْرِنـَا الأَيـَّامُ
b: Through you, the days of our lives are blissful,
And your presence has ennobled all the worlds.
You have been given all praiseworthy traits,
So rejoice! The banners have been unfolded for you.
The Guardian favored you with a gift,
That the pens cannot expound on.
You are foremost in all virtues,
So proceed, for you are the Imam of everyone.
All attributes of honor have been contained within you,
To you belongs elevation, glory, and majesty.
You have obtained all beauty entirely,
And the light of your face abolishes the darkness.

f: أَنْـتَ الَّذِي حَـارَ النُّهـَى فِي وَصْفِهِ
b: You are the one whose description has dumbfounded the eloquent,
And whose beauty has enraptured people's intellects.
O First, you have been preferred by Allah,
Whose will, favor, and blessing is pre-eternal.
When you appear to bear witness in the Hereafter,
Your soul, among all humanity, will be foremost.
The Lord's gifts have been showered upon you,
This has been fulfilled by His decree and ruling.

f: مـَا نَـالَ ذُو شَـرَفٍ وَقـَدْرٍ مِثْلَهَـا
b: No one has attained honor or worth like yours,
And all people of elevation and proximity have their station.
Allah is Supreme! Whenever you attained a rank,
Aspiration called out to you, "Continue forth!"
You continued to elevate and ascend,
And the angels in the heavenly realm were your servants.
Allah chose You to speak to Him after
Passing what the intellect could not fathom.
You came close to Him in truth
That is obscure to our understanding.
You attained, "or closer" and that was the greatest distinction,
And the Beloved's secrets are exalted.
Be joyous with the secret you have been given
And proximity, majesty, and honor.
From the Exalted and Holy Presence,
You received salutations and peace.
You heard what cannot be heard,

f: وَعَقَلـْتَ مَـا عَنْـهُ الوَرَى قَدْ نَامُوا
b: And understood what others are asleep too.
The intellects cannot conceive of the reality
Of the revelation and inspiration you receive.

f: يَـا سَـيِّدَ الكَـونَيْنِ يَا خَيْرَ الوَرَى
b: O Master of Both Abodes, O Best of Creation,
The one who has hope in you has faithfully composed these lines.
A servant who remains ignited in love of you,
And yearns and longs for you.
A love that has taken hold of my heart,
Its fire within me has set my insides ablaze.
So save him, O savior of the regretful, with a breeze,
That heals his sickness and diseases.
And favor him with a gaze that removes
Rust and darkness from his heart.
Of which gentleness spreads to his secret,
Strengthening his Iman and Islam.
And he remains upright on your Straight Path,
Through knowledge his feet remain firm.

f: يـَا مَـنْ عَلَيْـهِ مُعَوَّلِي فـِي كُلِّ مَا
b: O one who I rely on in everything
That I seek, and from him I hope for favors and blessing.
Whenever the hopeful seek you,

f: مِـنْ فَيـْضِ جُـودِكُ والعَطَا مَا رَامُوا
b: They receive from the outpouring of your generosity gifts beyond their desires.
I stand at the door, and you are the greatest of all that is sought,
That the souls and bodies yearn for.

f: فَاسْمَحْ وَجُدْ لِي بِالوِصَالِ فَفِي الحَشَا
b: Permit and favor me with a connection,
For in my heart there is yearning and the fire of love.

f: وَعَلَيْـكَ صَـلَّى اللَّـهُ يَا عَلَمَ الهُدَى
b: And may Allah's blessings be upon you, O Banner of Guidance,
Whenever doves coo on branches.
And upon you Family and Companions, the Foremost
They surpassed, for the Noble One's Companions and noble.
May God's blessings be upon Taha, the Yemeni,
The intercessor for creation on the Day of Resurrection.
Leave me, for the one I love has called me,
And for me, He has revealed signs of glad tidings.
And He has made clear to me the subtle meanings,
With certainty, when He unveiled the veil
He gave me to drink and I would sacrifice myself for who gave me to drink
Verily, to God belongs that wine
And he released the shackles after being tested
And bestow upon me all kinds of generosity
And in love, he clarified my intention and my state
With piety, he kept me away from blame.
My time passed in knowledge and piety
And in the Hereafter, to the abode of permanence.
And when the guide of the caravan led me,

f: إِلَى سَفْحِ النَّقَا مَا بَيْنَ رَامَة
b: To the slope of purity, between Ramat.
I responded to him, and did not bend my reins
To a backbiter or the people of blame.
And suffice it for me that I am at the door,
On the threshold, until the Day of Resurrection.
Ask me, for love is my art and my state,
And I have become, O my friend, a servant.
We were present with them at the wine of Dini,
On which the clouds rained down upon them.

f: وَهُمْ فِي السُّكْرِ مَا شَهِدُوا لِثَانِي
b: And in their intoxication, they did not testify to a second,
And between them, there is a sign from the Lord.

f: تَدُلُّ عَلَى الرِّضَا فِي كُلِّ آنِي
b: A sign that points to His satisfaction at every moment,
And they do not fear the regret of its consequences.
For them are abundant gifts of grace,
By which they attained the leadership.
Perhaps with them, we will reach the abode of the gardens,
And the Prophet ﷺ will lead us, the leaders of the way.
Upon Him, may Allah bless every moment,
And His family, as the dove of the morning coos.

f: الله الله يا الله الله الله يا الله
b: Allah Allah, O Allah, Allah Allah, O Allah
And prayers upon the chosen one, the best of beloveds
The beloved intercessor, the source of all gifts

f: الوَسِيْلَةْ لَنَا فِي نَيْلِ كُلِّ المَطَالِبْ
b: The means for us to attain all desires

f: فِي رِضَا سَيِّدِي لُفَّتْ جَمِيْعُ المَآرِبْ
b: In the satisfaction of my master, all goals are wrapped

f: كُلُّ سَاعَةْ وَمِنْ حَضْرَتِهْ تَبْدُو عَجَائِبْ
b: Every hour, wonders appear from his presence
Our purity is purified from all blemishes

f: قَطِّ مَا غَابَ حَتَّى انْ كُنْتَ عَنْ ذَاكَ غَائِبْ
b: He never disappeared, even if you were absent from that

f: يَا حَبِيْبَ المُهَيْمِنْ عَبِدْ بِالبَابِ تَائِبْ
b: O beloved of the Dominant, a servant at the door repenting

f: وَإِلَى اللّٰهْ بِكُمْ يَا سَيِّدَ الرُّسْلِ آيِبْ
b: And to Allah with you, O master of messengers, returning
From you, our beginning, and to you the consequences

f: إِنَّنِي فِي نَوَالِ الحَقِّ مَوْلاَيَ رَاغِبْ
b: Indeed, I am eager for the truth, my master

f: بِكْ إِلَيْكَ الرَّغَبْ نَطْلُبْ مَعَ كُلِّ طَالِبْ
b: With you, to you, we seek with every seeker
O Lord, we have sought intercession with the best of beloveds

f: سَيِّدَ الرُّسْلِ عَبْدُكْ خَيْرُ مَحْبُوبْ نَائِبْ
b: Master of the messengers, your servant, the best beloved deputy
And by his honor, my God, repel all calamities
And suffice us from all kinds of trials and troubles
And disasters, and all disturbances and hardships

f: واَلْحِقِ الكُلَّ مِنْ صَحْبِي بِخَيْرِ الكَتَائِبْ
b: And join all my companions with the best of troops
The blessing of the chosen one, of high stature and virtues
The seal of the prophets, the chosen, the sun of the unseen
Master of the messengers, Ahmad, generous in gifts
Every moment, his showers are pouring down

f: رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلَيْه وَالِهْ وَمَنْ لَهْ مُصَاحِبْ
b: O Lord, send blessings upon him and his family and those who accompany him
O Light of My Eye
O Taha, the sublime
Intercede for me tomorrow with Allah
I am fearful of the Fire
Joyous is he who visits
The Blessed Garden of the Chosen One
And he chose the abode of the Guide (The Prophet ﷺ) as his own abode
In the blessed company of the descendant of Adnan
You are the beloved
You are the Sought One
You are the one near to Allah
O Beloved of the Most Merciful
You strengthened Islam
You rejected the idols
You fulfilled the trust of delivering Allah’s guidance to the Ummah
O master of eloquent speech
O father of Ibrahim عليه السلام
O cure for the sick
Heal our ailments, beloved of Allah
O healer of all creation
May the Lord send blessings
Upon the tender-hearted one who turns to his Lord
Muḥammad, son of ʿAbdullāh
As long as the universe glimmers

Rejoice and be happy, O one who celebrates
In the Guide (Muhammad ﷺ), and recite the verse: 'Did We not expand your chest?'
In your honor of your Lord, you will be delightful
Recite the words of Allah the Greatest!

Listen to the great favor of Allah — His blessed words in the Qur’an

And heard words that cannot be shared
When the Lote Tree was covered in mystery...
...with blessings and goodness worth mentioning

Allah, the Almighty King, has said:
