Through you, Allah revealed the glory of His dominion
And by His will, the messengers were increased in light
And Allah said: 'We took a solemn covenant from them—
That if you, O Muhammad ﷺ, were sent to them, they would surely support you.'

f: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلَى الرَّاقِي إِلَى الرُّتَبِ
b: O Lord, bless the one who ascended to the highest ranks

f: في لَيْلَةِ السَّبْعِ والعِشْرِينَ مِنْ رَجَبِ
b: On the twenty-seventh night of Rajab

f: فِي لَيْلَةِ القُدْسِ أَمَّ الرُّسُلَ سَيِّدُنا
b: On the Holy Night, our Master led the Messengers
Taha the beloved, the Imam of the Arabs and the Non-Arabs

f: عَلَا عَلَى السَّبْعِ نَاجَى اللهَ خَالِقَهُ
b: He rose above the seven heavens and spoke to his Creator, Allah ﷻ

f: فِيْ رُتْبَةٍ قَد عَلَتْ حَقَّاً عَلَى الرُّتَبِ
b: In a rank that has truly risen above ranks
Beneath Him, the messengers and the angels, all of them

f: لِقَابِ قَوْسَيْنِ أَوْ أَدْنَى ٱصْطُفِى وَحُبِّى
b: At two bow lengths or even closer, he was chosen and brought near

f: يَا رَبِّ وَفِّرْ عَطَانَا هَبْ لَنَا حِكَمَاً
b: O Lord, grant us abundantly and give us wisdom
Do not disappoint the supplications of those who pray
And unite and bring together the hearts of Muslims on
What pleases you and relieve all the distress

f: يَا رَبِّ وَانْظُرْ إِلَيْنَا هَبْ لَنَا فَرَجَاً
b: Oh Lord, gaze upon us and grant us relief

f: وَاجْعَلْ لَنَا مَخْرَجَاً مِنْ أَيِّ مَا نَصَبِ
b: And make for us a way out from whatever we are afflicted with

f: بَارَكَ لَنَا فِي الَّذِي أَعْطَيْتَهُ وَتَوَلَّــنَـا
b: Bless us in what you have given us and taken care of us
Grant us good health and keep us safe from harm

f: يا مَن سَرَيْتَ لَيْلًا مُصاحِبَ جِبْرِيلَ
b: O you who traveled at night, accompanied Gabriel عليه السلام

f: لِلمسجد الأَقْصَى فِي تِلْكَ اللَّيْلَةِ ‎فِي تِلْكَ اللَّيْلَةِ
b: To Al-Aqsa Mosque that night that night

f: حَبِيبِي يا مُحَمَّد يا صادِقًا بِالوَعْدِ يا أَحْمَد يا مُؤَيَّد مِنَ الفَرْدِ الصَّمَد
b: My beloved, O Muhammad, O truthful in promise, O Ahmad, O supported by the One, the Eternal Refuge

f: يا صادِقَ المَقالِ يا ذَا المَقامِ العالِي يا مَن حَبَاهُ رَبِّي بِطِيبِ الأَفْعالِ
b: O truthful in speech, O possessor of high status, O he whom my Lord has endowed with good deeds
O you who traveled at night, accompanied Gabriel عليه السلام

f: لِلمسجد الأَقْصَى فِي تِلْكَ اللَّيْلَةِ ‎فِي تِلْكَ اللَّيْلَةِ
b: To Al-Aqsa Mosque that night that night

f: ‎صَلَّيْتَ يا مُحَمَّد بِجَمْعِ المُرْسَلِينَ كُنْتَ فِيهِمْ إِمامًا وَكانُوا مُهْتَدِينَ
b: You, O Muhammad, led the Messengers in prayer. You were their leader and they were guided.

f: ‎ثُمَّ بَعْدَ الصَّلاةِ سِرْتَ لِلسَّماواتِ فَوْقَ ظَهْرِ البُراقِ لِرَبِّ العالَمِينَ
b: Then after the prayer, you traveled to the heavens above the back of Al-Buraq to the Lord of the Worlds.
O you who traveled at night, accompanied Gabriel عليه السلام

f: لِلمسجد الأَقْصَى فِي تِلْكَ اللَّيْلَةِ ‎فِي تِلْكَ اللَّيْلَةِ
b: To Al-Aqsa Mosque that night that night

f: ‎بِيُمْنٍ وَسُرُورٍ وَفَوْقَ السِّدْرَةِ وَأُنْسٍ وَحُضُورٍ لِقُدْسِ الحَضْرَةِ
b: With happiness and joy, above the lote tree, and with familiarity and presence in the sanctity of the Allah's Presence.

f: حَيَّاكْ إِلى هُنا وَقَدْ نِلْتَ المُنى يا مَنْ حَبَاهُ رَبِّي بِطِيبِ الأَفْعالِ
b: Welcome here, you have achieved your wish, O one whom my Lord has blessed with good deeds.
O you who traveled at night, accompanied Gabriel عليه السلام

f: لِلمسجد الأَقْصَى فِي تِلْكَ اللَّيْلَةِ ‎فِي تِلْكَ اللَّيْلَةِ
b: To Al-Aqsa Mosque that night that night
My beloved, O Muhammad, O true to promise

f: يا أَحْمَد يا مُؤَيَّد مِنَ الفَرْدِ الصَّمَدِ
b: Oh Ahmed, oh supported by the One, the Eternal Refuge

f: يَا رَبِّي صَلِّ عَلَى النَّبِي مَنْ جَائَنَا بِالرِّسَالَةْ
b: O my Lord, send blessings upon the Prophet ﷺ who brought us the message

f: طَهَ مُحَمَّدْ وَأَلِهِ مَنْ كَلَّمَتْهُ الغَزَالَةْ
b: Taha Muhammad and his family, to whom the gazelle spoke

f: تَحْتَ بَابِ الرَّجَا أَطْرُقْهُ فِي كُلِّ حَالَةْ
b: Under the door of hope, I knock in every situation

f: بَابِ مَا أَوْسَعُهْ مَنْ بِهْ قَامْ حَازَ الجَمَالَةْ
b: The door is vast, and whoever stands by it gains beauty

f: فَاسْمَعُوا يَا أَحِبَّةْ قُولُ أَحْسَنْ دَلَالَةْ
b: Listen, O beloved ones, to the best guidance

f: وَاسْمَعُوا مِنْ لِسَانِ الْصِّدِقْ صِدْقِ المَقَالَةْ
b: And hear from the tongue of truth the truth of the words

f: الْنَّبِي لِـي حِمَى مَا أَشْهَدْ إِلَّا جَمَالَهْ
b: The Prophet ﷺ is my protector, I witness nothing but his beauty

f: قَرَّ فِي قَلْبِي إنَّ الصِّدِقْ مَا كَانْ قَالَهْ
b: It settled in my heart that truth is what he said

f: قَدْ حَمَلْ حِمْلَنَا يَا خَيْرَ تِلْكَ الحِمَالَةْ
b: He carried our burden, O best of those who carry

f: وَهُوَ قَاسِمْ وَأَنْعِمْ بِهْ بِيَومِ الكَيَالَةْ
b: He is the distributor, and blessed is he on the Day of Judgment

f: مَا خَلَقْ رَبُّنَا فِي الكَوْنِ كُلَّهْ مِثَالَهْ
b: Our Lord created nothing in the universe like him
He is the first and the last, and the heights are his shadows
And the field of intercession on the Day of Resurrection is his field
God honored his attributes and dignified his qualities
God magnified his states and glorified his traits

f: وَلَهُ الجَاهُ الأَعْظَمْ فِي اللِّقِا وَاللِّوَا لَهْ
b: He has the greatest prestige in the meeting, and the banner is his
He has the precedence, and then the means are his right

f: رَبِّ عَبْدُكْ بِهِ يَسأَلَكْ فَاقْبَلْ سُؤَالَهْ
b: Lord, your servant asks you through him, so accept his request

f: أُنْصُرْ أُنْصُرْ جُيُوشَ الحَقِّ يَاذَا الجَلَالَةْ
b: Support, support the armies of truth, O Majestic One

f: وَخِذْلْ خِذْلٌ لِأَهْلِ ٱلْبَغْيِ وَأَهْلِ ٱلضَّلَالَةْ
b: And defeat, defeat the people of tyranny and the people of misguidance

f: وَاجْمَعْ الشَّمْلَ بِاحْمَدْ سَيِّدْ اَهْلِ الرِّسَالَةْ
b: Unite the assembly with Ahmad, the master of the message bearers

f: وَاصْلِحْ أَحْوَالَ أَهْلِ الوَقْتِ بِهْ فِي عُجَالَةْ
b: And rectify the conditions of the people of the time through him quickly

f: وَاصْلِحْ أَحْوَالَ أَهْلِ الوَقْتِ بِهْ فِي عُجَالَةْ
b: And rectify the conditions of the people of the time through him quickly
Make our times good, so we ascend the ranks of guidance

f: فِي مَحَاضِرِهْ نُسْقَى يَا إِلَهِي زُلَالَه
b: In his presence, we are given to drink, O my God, the purest drink

f: كُلُّ لَحْظَةْ نَذُوقْ يَاذَا المَوَاهِبْ وِصَالَهْ
b: Every moment we taste, O Bestower, his connection

f: رَبِّ صِلِّ عَلَيْهْ فِي كُلِّ شَانٍ وَحَالَةْ
b: Lord, send blessings upon him in every matter and state
And upon his family and companions as long as we hear the words
Between his shoulders is a sign:
the seal of all the Noble Messengers
The full moon (i.e, the Prophet ﷺ) has shined upon us
and the physical moon has been completed hidden
The likeness of your beauty, we have never seen
In the two Iraqs (Iraq and Iran), nor in the Levant
O beloved, O Muhammad
O beloved of the two creations
O assisted one, O honored one
O leader of the two Qiblas
Whoever sees your face is felicitous
O one of noble parents
Your cool pure water basin
is where we will drink on the Crowded Day
My Lord, make our gathering
its finality a beautiful seal
And give us what we have asked for
From you immense blessings
And honor our spirits
to meet the greatest of creation.
Send to the chosen one from us
Of blessings and peace
Muḥammad - noblest of the Arabs and the non-Arabs

f: مُحَمَّدٌ خَيْرُ مَنْ يَمْشِي عَلَى قَدَمِ
b: Muḥammad - best of all those who walk upon two feet
Muḥammad - most expansive giver of all good things
Muḥammad - the master of excellence and generosity
Muḥammad - crown of the Messengers of God without exception
Muḥammad - in speech and word the one most true
Muḥammad - utterly reliable in keeping trusts
Muḥammad - whose character and qualities are excellent indeed
Muḥammad - his substance watered by light

f: مُحَمَّدٌ لَمْ يَزَلْ نُورًا مِنَ الْقِدَمِ
b: Muḥammad - a light still shining from before eternity
Muḥammad - fair and wise in judgement, the noble one,
Muḥammad - source of kindness and wisdom

f: مُحَمَّدٌ خَيْرُ خَلْقِ اللهِ مِنْ مُضَرٍ
b: Muḥammad - finest of God’s creation, who came from Muḍar
Muḥammad - of all God’s Messengers the best
Muḥammad : his creed is true, by it we profess our faith
Muḥammad - eminent, the embodiment of truth
Muḥammad - to mention him brings refreshment to our souls
Muḥammad - praising him is a duty upon all peoples
Muḥammad - the beauty of the world and its splendour
Muḥammad - who lifts the veils of darkness and distress
Muḥammad - a master, whose virtues bring delight
Muḥammad - the Most Merciful fashioned him from grace
Muḥammad - the flower of the Creator and His elect
Muḥammad - pure beyond all suspicion
Muḥammad - smiling and cheerful with his guest to honour him,
Muḥammad - by God, no neighbour of his was ever wronged!
Muḥammad - this world was made delightful by his being sent
Muḥammad - he came with signs and with wisdom
Muḥammad - our intercessor on the Day mankind is resurrected
Muḥammad - whose light is the guide out of darkness
Muḥammad : dedicated to God, he of the highest aspiration
Muḥammad - the Seal of the Messengers, every one of them.
O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, I halted my mount
at your doorstep! Greetings to You from me!
O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, I halted my mount
at your doorstep! Greetings to You from me!
Knowing that you are the exalted fortress
What a wonderful state when The Chosen one is my stronghold
O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, I halted my mount
at your doorstep! Greetings to You from me!
Truly You are The Mercy of The Most Merciful
encompassing all creatures, humans, and Jinns
The Divine as crowned you with a crown of Might
and Nobility, So Please My Master!! Take me!
O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, I halted my mount
at your doorstep! Greetings to You from me!
to a light which cleanses the rust of my heart
and fills it with knowledges from you, made wholesome
You are the city filled with divine knowledges
And Ali رضي الله عنه is its gate in every discipline
O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, I halted my mount
at your doorstep! Greetings to You from me!
I ask you for knowledge of your Sharia, O My Beloved
so by The Two Hasans, and The Resplendent please Answer me!
Provide me with vast secrets
so benefitting the Muslims becomes my task
O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, I halted my mount
at your doorstep! Greetings to You from me!
Your High rank with Him is truly immense
By it, on the Gathering, you are close to the All-Merciful
and You intercede for the judgment, on the Day of Grief
for those who visit you with a Beautiful opinion of you
O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, I halted my mount
at your doorstep! Greetings to You from me!
You relieve them of a mighty sorrow
None but you dispel and divert it
Because you are the most noble of the chosen in rank
Beloved of Allah, Enrich me!
O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, I halted my mount
at your doorstep! Greetings to You from me!
The Divine aided you with every good
and The Quran as if a sun that suffices
Its virtues envelop the cosmos with light
and clear guidance to the Gardens of Eden
O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, I halted my mount
at your doorstep! Greetings to You from me!
The safety of the Muslims, of glorious rank
Intercessor for the one who incurs harms
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ is the call to help, Nay life saving help itself
removing every blemish from humanity
O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, I halted my mount
at your doorstep! Greetings to You from me!
His Noble Rawdah O our brothers
gladdens the heart from every worry and sorrow
In it is solace,sweetness, and light
In it is my felicity, my guidance, and my success
O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, I halted my mount
at your doorstep! Greetings to You from me!
In it is The Chosen One, you will see him smiling
greeting the visitors in total safety
He gives glad tidings of what they came for
and intercedes for all without any delay
O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, I halted my mount
at your doorstep! Greetings to You from me!
May Allah send upon him Prayer for all times
with the honorable greeting of peace, so long as the cameleers chant
and upon the Family, then the Noble Companions
O People of Allah, those who have alighted in Eden
O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, I halted my mount
at your doorstep! Greetings to You from me!
To You Ja'fari came singing praises
O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, I have beautified my opinion (of you)
He is the light that guides the confused with its radiance
And on the Day of Gathering, the shade of the messengers is his banner
He received from the unseen a wisdom
With it, his sky rained upon the two horizons
And the witnessed truth from him are subtleties
That tell that glory and ambition are his ambition

f: فَلِلَّهِ مَا لِلْعَيْنِ مِنْ مَشْهَدِ ٱجْتِلَى
b: For God, what the eye witnesses is a scene
Difficult for those veiled to perceive
O you who are distant from me, yet his dwelling is in my heart

f: أَجِبْ مَنْ مَلَا كُلَّ ٱلنَّوَاحِي نِدَاؤُهُ
b: Answer the one whose call fills all directions

f: أَجِبْ مَنْ تَوَلَّاهُ ٱلْهَوَى فِيكَ وَٱمْضِ فِي
b: Answer the one whom passion has taken over in you and proceed
In my heart whatever love desires and wishes

f: بَنَى ٱلْحُبُّ فِي وَسْطِ ٱلْفُؤَادِ مَنَازِلًا
b: Love has built in the midst of the heart dwellings
So for God, a builder whose construction surpasses in craftsmanship
By the rule of loyalty, I have stripped my intention, and how delightful
Are the allies whose loyalty has comforted the heart
I fell ill, and remembrance was a cure for my ailment
So how delightful is the remembrance that heals my heart

f: إِذَا عَلِمَ العُشَّاقُ دَاءِ فَقُلْ لَهُمْ
b: If the lovers knew the ailment, tell them
For meeting the beloveds of my heart is its remedy
O traveler, convey a message to my beloved
With a letter of longing that sweetens its spelling

f: وَهَيْهَاتَ أَنْ يَلْقَى الْعَذُولُ إِلَى الْحَشَا
b: And far be it that the critic finds a way to the heart
Whether in praise or criticism
My heart is enamored with the best of messengers
And the most honorable thing that pleases my ear is his praise

f: رَقَى فِي الْعُلَى وَالْمَجْدِ أَشْرَفَ رُتْبَةٍ
b: He ascended in the heights and glory to the most noble rank
In his origin, creation wondered how his end would be
O my master, my heart is exposed with your love
And my eyes, after tears, flow with blood

f: إِذَا رُمْتُ كَتْمَ الحُبِّ زَادَتْ صَبَابَتِي
b: If I sought to hide love, my yearning increased
So it is the same to me whether it is revealed or concealed

f: أَجِبْ يَا حَبِيبَ الْقَلْبِ دَعْوَةَ شَيِّقٍ
b: Answer, O beloved of the heart, the call of the longing one

f: شَكَا لَفْحَ نَارٍ قَدْ حَوَتْهَا حَشَاؤُهُ
b: Who complained of the burning fire that his heart contained
And command your blessed glance in the heedlessness of enemies
To pass with a look that increased your weeping

f: لِيَ ٱللَّهُ مِنْ حُبٍّ تَعَسَّرَ وَصْفُهُ
b: By God, from a love whose description is difficult
And to God belongs my affair, and the decree is His decree
O Lord, honor me with the vision of my master
And clear the echo of the heart, which has much resonance

f: وَبَلِّغْ عَلِيًّ مَا يَرُومُ مِنَ ٱلْلِّقَا
b: And grant Ali رضي الله عنه what he desires from the meeting
With the most honorable servant, my ultimate aim is his meeting
Upon him be God's prayers as long as the east wind blows
And as long as the singer's song delights and his melody pleases

f: مَعَ ٱلْآلِ وَلْاَ صْحَابِ مَا قَالَ مُنْشِدٌ
b: With the family and companions, as long as a singer says
He is the light that guides the confused with its radiance

f: مَطْلَبِي مِنْ حَبِيبِ القَلْبِ رُؤْيَةْ مُحَيَّاهْ
b: My desire from the beloved of my heart is to see his countenance

f: رَبِّ حَقِّقْ لِقَلْبِي كُلَّ مَا قَدْ تَمَنَّاهْ
b: My Lord, realize for my heart all that I desire

f: فَإِنَّ قِدْ لِي زَمَنْ يَا رَبِّ أَشْتَاقْ رُؤْيَاهْ
b: For I have, for so long, My Lord, have longed to see him

f: بَخِتْ مَنْ شَرَّفَ المَوْلَى بُرُؤْيَةْ عَيْنَاهْ
b: Glad tidings to whomever the Master has blessed to see him

f: يَا سَمِيعَ الدُّعَا حَقَّقْ لِذَا القَلِبْ رَجْوَاهْ
b: O One who hears supplications, realize for this heart its hope

f: طَالَتْ أَيَّامْ بُعْدِي عَنْهُ فَادْرِكْ بِلُقْيَاهْ
b: long have been the days of distance from him. Urgently facilitate a meeting with him

f: مَا احْسَنَ اوْصَافُهُ العُظْمَى وَمَا احْسَنْ سَجَايَاهْ
b: How beautiful are his amazing traits. How beautiful his character

f: عَاشَتِ الرُّوحْ بِهْ فِي أُنُسْ مَا احْسَنُهْ وَاحْلَاهْ
b: the spirit lives in intimate comfort through him. How beautiful! How pleasant!

f: يَا نَدِيمِي أَدِرْ ذِكْرَهْ عَلَيّْ فَأَنِّي أَهْوَاهْ
b: O companion, pass around his mention, for indeed, I love him!

f: وَاذْكُرْ أَيَّامْ فِيهَا قَدْ نَفَحْ طِيبْ رَيَّاهْ
b: Mention the days in which the pure fragrance exuded

f: عَرِفْ طَيِّبْ إِذَا مَا شَمَّهُ المَيِّتْ أَحْيَاهْ
b: Breath the fragrance that the dead would come to life by smelling

f: جَدِّدُوا لِي صَفَا وَقْتِي وَأُنْسِي بِذِكْرَاهْ
b: Renew the purity of my time and comfort through his mention

f: وَاذْكُرُوا لِي عُهُودِي المَاضِيَةْ بَيْنْ أَفْيَاهْ
b: Remind me of my past covenants

f: فَانَّنِي قَدْ رَضِيتِهِ كُلَّ مَا كَانَ يَرْضَاهْ
b: For I am pleased with all that he is pleased with

f: وَانَّنِي عَبِدْ لُهْ مَمْلُوكْ فِي كُلِّ مَا شَاهْ
b: And I am his servant, he can do with me as he pleases

f: لَيْسَ لِي قَصِدْ فِي كُلِّ الوَرَى غَيْرْ إِيَّاهْ
b: I have no objective in creation save him

f: كَمْ وَكَمْ عَبِدْ بِهْ قَدْ طَالْ فِي الكَوْنِ مَبْنَاهْ
b: How many servants whose foundations have lasted through him

f: كَمْ وَكَمْ سِرّْ عِنْدَ الذِّكْرِ لُهْ قَدْ وَجَدْنَاهْ
b: How many secrets have we found through mentioning him

f: قَدْ طَعِمْنَاهْ يَا لِلّٰهْ مَا قَدْ طَعِمْنَاهْ
b: We have experience from him, from Allah, what we have experienced

f: كَمْ وَكَمْ عَهِدْ لُهْ فِي السِّرِّ مِنَّا حَفِظْنَاهْ
b: How many of his covenants have we guarded secretly

f: يَا سَمِيعَ الدُّعَا وَفِّرْ عَلِيّ مِنْ عَطَايَاهْ
b: O hearer of supplications, grant me in full from his gifts
and for my entire family, children, companions, and loved ones

f: وَالصَّلَاةُ عَلَيْهِ إِنُّهْ غِنَى مَنْ تَوَلَّاهْ
b: and prayers be upon him - he is the sufficiency for all who are loyal to him

f: وَالصَّلَاةُ عَلَيْهْ إِنُّهْ غِنَى مَنْ تَوَلَّاهْ
b: and prayers be upon him - he is the sufficiency for all who are loyal to him
My heart and your heart are intertwined,
My concern and your concern are shared.
The Prophet's ﷺ gaze surrounds us,
And from him, we gain protection.
The compassion of the Messenger ﷺ has captured us,
And we have fallen into the net.

f: وَ لَـقَدْ دَعَــاكَ وَ قَـدْ كَسَاكْ
b: Indeed, he called you, clothed you,
He bestowed upon you and adorned you.
This is the knowledgeable Imam,
Your famous Sheikh has welcomed you.
You have been a support to the beloved,
So rejoice, for support is yours.
Advance and do not heed those
Who are bewildered by you and plot against you.
The state of the Prophet's ﷺ cousin,
My master Ja'far, has clothed you.
And rejoice, for all goodness,
All goodness in both worlds is yours.
O Most Merciful of the merciful
O Most Merciful of the merciful
O Most Merciful of the merciful
Relieve the Muslims
O our Lord, O Generous
O our Lord, O Merciful
You are the Generous, the Forbearing
And You are the Best Helper
And we hope for none but You
So save us, O my God, save us
Before annihilation and destruction
Encompass the world and religion
O Most Merciful of the merciful
O Most Merciful of the merciful
O Most Merciful of the merciful
Relieve the Muslims
And we have no one, O our Lord
But You, O our Sufficiency
O Possessor of Glory and Wealth
O Strong, O Firm
We ask You for a guardian to establish
Justice so we may be upright
On Your straight guidance
And not obey the accursed
O Most Merciful of the merciful
O Most Merciful of the merciful
O Most Merciful of the merciful
Relieve the Muslims
O our Lord, O Responsive
You are the All-Hearing, the Near
The vast, spacious has become narrow
So look upon the believers
A look that removes distress
From us and brings wishes
Closer to us and all happiness
We are granted at all times
O Most Merciful of the merciful
O Most Merciful of the merciful
O Most Merciful of the merciful
Relieve the Muslims
We ask by the honor of the ancestors
For a guardian who establishes the limits
From us and suffices against the envious
And repels the wrongdoers
Removes the evils
Establishes the prayers
Commands the righteous deeds
Loves the righteous
O Most Merciful of the merciful
O Most Merciful of the merciful
O Most Merciful of the merciful
Relieve the Muslims
Removes all forbidden things
Overcomes all tyrants
Is just among the people
And secures the fearful
O Lord, give us abundant rain
Beneficial, blessed, everlasting
That continues every year
Throughout the passing years
O Most Merciful of the merciful
O Most Merciful of the merciful
O Most Merciful of the merciful
Relieve the Muslims
O Lord, let us live grateful
And let us die as Muslims
And be resurrected among the secure
In the company of the foremost
By the honor of Taha the Messenger ﷺ
Grant us, O our Lord, acceptance
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Our Lord
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Our Sufficiency
O Lord unite - Allah my Master -
O Lord unite our affairs by the Intercessor!

f: طَابَ قَلْبِي وَ سُقِي كَأْسَ الهَنَا
b: My heart is at peace, and has been nourished by the drink of joy

f: وَ حَبِيبُ القَلْبِ مِنِّي قَدْ دَنَا
b: Because the Beloved of my heart has drawn close to me
His light has enveloped
the heart like a radiant full moon.
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Our Lord
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Our Sufficiency
O Lord unite - Allah my Master -
O Lord unite our affairs by the Intercessor!
Therefore, my state has become pure,
And I have attained vast bounties due to this benevolence,
These are sublime outpourings,
greater than what intellectual vast minds can comprehend.
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Our Lord
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Our Sufficiency
O Lord unite - Allah my Master -
O Lord unite our affairs by the Intercessor!
Divine gifts of God, our Lord,
Our Sufficiency, beyond count or comprehension
By virtue of the Intercessor,
His chosen slave, His grace has embraced us.
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Our Lord
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Our Sufficiency
O Lord unite - Allah my Master -
O Lord unite our affairs by the Intercessor!
He is the best of creation and our treasure.
He is the bearer of secrets to perfection and our pride.
His station is raised,
every inward and outward manifestation of it.
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Our Lord
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Our Sufficiency
O Lord unite - Allah my Master -
O Lord unite our affairs by the Intercessor!
He is the Beloved of the Almighty, our Lord.
The Seal of the trustworthy dignified Prophets
The One whose intercession is accepted
before any other intercessor on the day of great difficulty.
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Our Lord
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Our Sufficiency
O Lord unite - Allah my Master -
O Lord unite our affairs by the Intercessor!
Ahmed the Praiseworthy, Taha, He is our fortress.
The Master of all Sayyids, He is our safe haven.
An impenetrable stronghold
from all bad and evil.
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Our Lord
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Our Sufficiency
O Lord unite - Allah my Master -
O Lord unite our affairs by the Intercessor!
O Possessor of great generosity, unite us by virtue of
Our Beloved and show us his countenance, O Lord!
So we may delight
In witnessing his beauty and splendor.
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Our Lord
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Our Sufficiency
O Lord unite - Allah my Master -
O Lord unite our affairs by the Intercessor!
Upon the station of closeness, let us taste spiritual proximity
To the Beloved, He who is characterized by, “the One who was drawn close”
Who all beauty is combined
Within Him secretly and openly.
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Our Lord
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Our Sufficiency
O Lord unite - Allah my Master -
O Lord unite our affairs by the Intercessor!

f: وَ بِهِ ارْبُطْ كُلَّ حَالٍ حَبْلَنَا
b: By Him, keep us spiritually connected at all times,

f: فِيْ الدُّنَا وَ بَرْزَخٍ وَ حَشْرِنَا
b: In this world, the intermediary realm and the hereafter.
And in the highest levels
Of Firdaus, unite us with our companions.
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Our Lord
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Our Sufficiency
O Lord unite - Allah my Master -
O Lord unite our affairs by the Intercessor!

f: رَبِّ مِنْ غَيْرِ امْتِحَانٍ أَوْ عَنَا
b: O Lord, without test or tribulation,

f: أَوْ عَذَابٍ فِي هُنَاكَ أَوْ هُنَا
b: Nor punishment or difficulty, neither here or in the next life.
O Lord, listen to our plea!
O whose generosity is vast, answer our prayer.
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Our Lord
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Our Sufficiency
O Lord unite - Allah my Master -
O Lord unite our affairs by the Intercessor!
Send blessings, O Lord, upon our Master
Ahmed and His Family, the pinnacle point of our happiness.
An overflowing and outpouring of Divine rain upon them,
The companions and all those who love us.

f: قَمَرٌ قَمَرٌ قَمَرٌ سِيدْنَا النَّبِي قَمَرٌ
b: The Moon, The likeness of our Prophet is like the moon

f: وَجَمِيلْ وَجَمِيلْ وَجَمِيلْ سِيدْنَا النَّبِي وَجَمِيلْ
b: Beautiful, Our master is truly beautiful

f: وَأَجْمَلُ مِنْكَ لَمْ تَرَ قَطُّ عَيْنٍ [ الله الله ]
b: More beautiful than you no eye has ever seen

f: وَأَطْيَبُ مِنْكَ لَمْ تَلِدِ النِّسَآءُ [ الله الله ]
b: And purer than you no woman ever givi birth to
You were created free from any flaw whatsoever
As if you were created just the way you wanted

f: قَمَرٌ قَمَرٌ قَمَرٌ سِيدْنَا النَّبِي قَمَرٌ
b: The Moon, The likeness of our Prophet is like the moon

f: وَجَمِيلْ وَجَمِيلْ وَجَمِيلْ سِيدْنَا النَّبِي وَجَمِيلْ
b: Beautiful, Our master is truly beautiful

f: وَكَفُّ الْمُصْطَفَى كَالْوَرْدِ نَادِي [ الله الله ]
b: The palm of the Chosen One is like a rose-petal, silken and dewy

f: وَعِطْرُهَا يَبْقَى اِذَا مَسَّتْ أَيَادِي [ الله الله ]
b: Its fragrant scent lingers upon the hands' brushing touch
Its great favor has encompassed all of humanity, and is widespread.
[Such is] the beloved of Allah. O very best of creation!

f: قَمَرٌ قَمَرٌ قَمَرٌ سِيدْنَا النَّبِي قَمَرٌ
b: The Moon, The likeness of our Prophet is like the moon

f: وَجَمِيلْ وَجَمِيلْ وَجَمِيلْ سِيدْنَا النَّبِي وَجَمِيلْ
b: Beautiful, Our master is truly beautiful

f: كَحِيلُ الطَّرْفِ حَبِيبِي لَوْ تَرَاهُ [ الله الله ]
b: Kohl-eyed is my beloved, were you to see him

f: ضَحُوكُ السِّنَّ لِلْعَاشِقْ رَمَاهُ [ الله الله ]
b: Cheerful and smiling, leaving his admirers utterly love-struck
Magnificent of appearance, for the Lord did choose him
While all of creation is lit up from the light of Ta-Ha

f: قَمَرٌ قَمَرٌ قَمَرٌ سِيدْنَا النَّبِي قَمَرٌ
b: The Moon, The likeness of our Prophet is like the moon

f: وَجَمِيلْ وَجَمِيلْ وَجَمِيلْ سِيدْنَا النَّبِي وَجَمِيلْ
b: Beautiful, Our master is truly beautiful

f: وَلَا ظِلُّ لَهُ بَلْ كَانَ نُورَا [ الله الله ]
b: He had no taint of shadow, rather he was light

f: تَنَالُ الشَّمْسَ مِنْهُ وَالْبُدُورَا [ الله الله ]
b: The moon and sun both benefited from him
There would have been no guidance without his appearance
The whole universe became illuminated through the light of Ta-Ha

f: قَمَرٌ قَمَرٌ قَمَرٌ سِيدْنَا النَّبِي قَمَرٌ
b: The Moon, The likeness of our Prophet is like the moon

f: وَجَمِيلْ وَجَمِيلْ وَجَمِيلْ سِيدْنَا النَّبِي وَجَمِيلْ
b: Beautiful, Our master is truly beautiful

f: وَرِيقُ المُصْطَفَى يَشْفِي العَلِيلَ [ الله الله ]
b: The saliva of the Chosen One heals the ailing, the sick.

f: وَعَيْنُ قَتَادَةَ خُذْهَا دَلِيلَا [ الله الله ]
b: Take the eye of Qatada as evidence [of this]
He spat in the well and it became a flowing spring
And it became like honey for his companions.
O Allah! Send blessing upon Muhammad!
O Lord! Send blessings upon him and peace!
If it is said: “You visited, so what did you return with?”
O Most Honorable of Creation, what shall we say?
Say: We returned with every good,
And the Original was united its Branch
O Allah! Send blessing upon Muhammad!
O Lord! Send blessings upon him and peace!
If not for you, o Beauty of existence
My living and existence would not be pleasant
And I would not have swayed (out of ecstasy) in my prayer
Nor in my ruku’ or my prostration
O Allah! Send blessing upon Muhammad!
O Lord! Send blessings upon him and peace!
O nights of contentment! To us
Return so my stem can turn green
Return to us with every goodness
With the Mustafa (Chose One), the One of pleasing forefathers
O Allah! Send blessing upon Muhammad!
O Lord! Send blessings upon him and peace!
Then prayers upon our Prophet
And his family, the ones in prostration and ruku’
And prayers upon Taha, the Prophet ﷺ of intercession

f: كُلَّ لَيْلَةْ ضِيَافَةْ مِنْ عَظِيْمِ المَوَاهِبْ
b: Every night a hospitality from the Great Giver

f: طَابَ قَلْبِي بِجُودِ اللهْ يَا خَيْرَ وَاهِبْ
b: My heart is pleased with the generosity of Allah, O best of givers
And prayers upon Taha, the Prophet ﷺ of intercession
The clouds of His grace and benevolence pour upon us

f: دَفَعَ اللهُ عَنْ أَقْطَارِنَا كُلّ شَاغِبْ
b: Allah has warded off every trouble from our lands
And prayers upon Taha, the Prophet ﷺ of intercession

f: جُودُ مَولايْ مَا يَحْسَبُهْ يَا نَاسْ حَاسِبْ
b: The generosity of my Lord is beyond calculation, O people

f: شُو عَطَا اللهْ وَاسِعْ مِنْ جَمِيْعِ الجَوَانِبْ
b: What Allah has given is vast from all sides
And prayers upon Taha, the Prophet ﷺ of intercession
Attracted me to the abode of the beloved ones
And the calls invited me to ascend the ranks
And prayers upon Taha, the Prophet ﷺ of intercession

f: فَرْقُ مَا بَيْنْ مَنْ يُخْطَبْ وَمَنْ كَانَ خَاطِبْ
b: The difference between one who is sought and one who is a suitor

f: يَا جَزِيْلَ العَطَا عَبْدُكْ عَلَى البَابِ رَاغِبْ
b: O generous giver, your servant is eager at the door
And prayers upon Taha, the Prophet ﷺ of intercession
So open the door and grant me abundant gifts

f: واصْلِح أَحْوَالَ أَوْلَادِي وَمَنْ لِي مُصَاحِبْ
b: And rectify the affairs of my children and those who accompany me
And prayers upon Taha, the Prophet ﷺ of intercession
And my household and my students and all my relatives

f: أَدْخِلِ الكُلَّ فِي زُمْرَةْ إِمَامِ الَأَطَائِبْ
b: Include everyone in the group of the pure Imam
And prayers upon Taha, the Prophet ﷺ of intercession

f: نَجْتَمِعْ فِي رِحَابِ الطُّهُرْ خَيْرَ الحَبَائِبْ
b: We gather in the sanctuaries of purity, the best of beloveds

f: نَتَّصِلْ بِهْ وَنَحْظَى فِي الِّلقَا بِالعَجَائِبْ
b: We connect with him and enjoy wonders in the meeting
O Book of the Unseen, we have sought refuge in you
O Healer of Hearts, prayers be upon you
You are the Opening, the seal of the Party of Success
And the beacon of righteousness shone from Your appearance

f: أَنْتَ رُوحُ الوُجُودْ كَنْزُ فَضْلٍ وَجُودْ
b: You are the soul of existence, a treasure of grace and generosity

f: فِي مَقَامِ الشُّهُودْ كُلُّ فَضْلٍ لَدَيْكْ
b: In the station of witnessing, all virtues are with you
O Book of the Unseen, we have sought refuge in you
O Healer of Hearts, prayers be upon you

f: أَنْتَ مَجْلَى الجَلَالْ فِي نِظَامِ الجَمَالْ
b: You are the manifestation of majesty in the system of beauty

f: كُلُّ هَذَا النَّوَالْ فَاضَ مِنْ رَاحَتَـيْكْ
b: All this bounty flowed from your hands

f: أَنْتَ سِرُّ الكِتَابْ عَنْكَ فَصْلُ الخِطَابْ
b: You are the secret of the Book, from you is the decisive word
And on the Day of Reckoning, the return is to you
O Book of the Unseen, we have sought refuge in you
O Healer of Hearts, prayers be upon you

f: أَنْتَ طَهَ الرَّسُولْ تَاجُ أَهْلِ القَبُولْ
b: You are Taha the Messenger ﷺ, the crown of the accepted ones
All my worries vanish by relying on you
The appearance of the Beloved is the ultimate goal
Whoever sees knows, and others are veiled
O Book of the Unseen, we have sought refuge in you
O Healer of Hearts, prayers be upon you
His face is apparent, brilliant in style
A luminous tablet inscribed in the universe
Exalted is He who created, His secret deposited
In the entire universe, so open the chamber
O Book of the Unseen, we have sought refuge in you
O Healer of Hearts, prayers be upon you
And peace be upon you, O Messenger of humanity
As long as the enamored sings with prayers upon you
Prayers and salutations be upon the one who brought us glad tidings
Tell our students, the breeze of glad tidings has approached

f: يَا هَنَا أَهْلِ الصَّفَا يَا فَوْزَ أَهْلِ الطَّهَارَةْ
b: O joy to the people of purity, O success for the people of sanctity
Prayers and salutations be upon the one who brought us glad tidings

f: قَدْ أَتَتْ يَا أَحِبَّةْ مِنْ حَبِيبِي إِشَارَةْ
b: A sign, O dear ones, has come from my beloved

f: هُوْ رَعَانِي وَلِي قَوَّمْ أَسَاسَ العِمَارَةْ
b: He nurtured me and established the foundation
Prayers and salutations be upon the one who brought us glad tidings

f: لَا بِجُهْدِي وَلَا حِيلَةْ وَلَا بِالمَهَارَةْ
b: Not by my effort, nor by my skill, nor by my expertise

f: خُذْ حَقَائِقْ وَلَا لِي غَيْرْ مَحْضِ السَّفَارَةْ
b: Take the truths, for I have nothing but pure sincerity in my service
Prayers and salutations be upon the one who brought us glad tidings

f: مَنْ قَصَدْ وَجْهَ رَبِّهْ قَدْ ظَفِرْ بِالإِمَارَةْ
b: Whoever seeks the pleasure of their Lord has certainly attained victory in leadership

f: مَنْ تَوَجَّهْ إِلَيْهْ بِالصِّدْقِ نَحَى السِّتَارَةْ
b: Whoever turns to Him with sincerity will be granted the removal of the veil
Prayers and salutations be upon the one who brought us glad tidings

f: وَبَدَتْ لُهْ مَعَانِي مَا تَسَعْهَا العِبَارَةْ
b: And to him will be revealed meanings that no expression can contain

f: وَبِهَا صَارَ لَيْلُهْ يَا الأَحِبَّةْ نَهَارَهْ
b: And through it, his night became as bright as day, O dear ones
Prayers and salutations be upon the one who brought us glad tidings

f: يَا إِلَهِي بِطَهَ وَاآلِهْ أَهْلِ الطَّهَارَةْ
b: O my Lord, by Taha and the people of purity, the people of sanctity
And the one who migrated, great in stature, lofty in dignity
Prayers and salutations be upon the one who brought us glad tidings
And the esteemed jurist, the leader of the people of excellence

f: وَابْنِ سَالِمْ وَكَمْ مِنْ وَجِهْ فِيهِ النَّضَارَةْ
b: And the son of Salim, and how many faces in him bear radiance
Prayers and salutations be upon the one who brought us glad tidings

f: أَصْلِحِ الشَّانْ يَا مَوْلَايْ وَأَطْفِ الحَرَارَةْ
b: Set right the affairs, O my Master, and put out the burning heat
Suppress the people of misguidance, envy, and impurity
Prayers and salutations be upon the one who brought us glad tidings

f: نَنْظُرْ أَعْلَامْ طَهَ قَدْ بَدَتْ فِي جِهَارَهْ
b: We look upon the signs of Taha, as they have appeared in his banner
Its lights shine in the interior and exterior
Prayers and salutations be upon the one who brought us glad tidings

f: وَاحْفَظِ الكُلَّ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا وَاحْمِ جَارَهْ
b: And protect all of our friends and protect their neighbors.

f: كُلَّ سَاعَةْ لَهُمْ تَأْتِي بِفَضْلِكَ بِشَارَةْ
b: Every hour brings them good news, thanks to you.
Prayers and salutations be upon the one who brought us glad tidings

f: وَاجْعَلِ الكُلَّ فِي الفِرْدَوْسْ يَا الله قَرَارَهْ
b: And make everyone’s abode in Paradise, O God.

f: مَعْ رِجَالِ النَّقَا أَجْمَعْ وَأَهْلِ الصَّدَارَةْ
b: With all the men of purity and the leaders
Prayers and salutations be upon the one who brought us glad tidings

f: مَنْهَجْ أَهْلِ الهُدَى لِي يَحْكُمُونَ السَّيَارَةْ
b: The approach of the people of guidance to rule the car

f: وَالصَّلَاةُ عَلَى مَنْ رَفَعَ اللهُ مَنَارَهْ
b: And prayers be upon the one whose beacon God raised
Prayers and salutations be upon the one who brought us glad tidings
Ahmad the Chosen One and his family, the people of purity
And the companions and whoever raised his slogan with his honesty

f: مَا فِي الوُجُودِ وَلَا فِي الْكَوْنِ مِنْ أَحَدٍ
b: None exists in the realm of existence, and in the vast cosmic expanse
but as a beggar, seeking the grace of the One, the Sole.
Dependent upon His benevolence, in need

f: لِفَيْضِ أَفْضَالِهِ يَا نِعْمَ مِنْ صَمَدِ
b: For the abundance of His favors, O The Pinnacle of Guardianship.

f: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ خَلَقَ الأَكْوَانَ مِنْ عَدَمٍ
b: Glorified is He who fashioned the cosmos from nothingness
Encompassing it with His bounties and support
Blessed is Allah, beyond count are His praises

f: وَلَيْسَ تُحْصَرُ فِي حَدٍّ وَلَا عَدَدِ
b: Not confined to limits, nor numbered amounts

f: اللهُ اللهُ رَبِّي لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ
b: Allah, Allah, my Lord, without any partner
Allah, Allah, my worship, and my inclination

f: اللهُ اللهُ لَا أَبْغِي بِهِ بَدَلًا
b: Allah, Allah, I seek with Him no substitute
Allah, Allah, my purpose, and my sole support within

f: اللهُ اللهُ لَا أُحْصِي ثَنَاهُ وَلَا
b: Allah, Allah, I'm unable to enumerate His praises
and I hope in none but Him for relief from distress and adversity
Allah, Allah, I petition Him humbly and I beseech Him
Allah, Allah, my hope, and my place of reliance

f: يَا فَرْدُ يَا حَيُّ يا قَيُّومُ يَا مَلِكًا
b: O The Unique One, O The Ever-Living

f: يَا أَوَّلًا أَزَلِي يَا آخِرًا أَبَدِي
b: O The Self-Sustaining, O The Sovereign,
O The Eternal First, O The Everlasting Last

f: أَنْتَ الْمُقَدَّسُ عَنْ زَوْجٍ وَعَنْ وَلَدِ
b: You are independent of all comparisons and partners
You are the refuge for one whose paths have constricted

f: وَمَنْ أَلَمَّ بِهِ خَطْبٌ مِنَ النَّكَدِ
b: And for one afflicted by speeches burdened with sorrow
You are the near, the responsive, the one sought for help
And You, O Lord, are for those who hope with keen anticipation
I implore You that you forgive me, and be merciful with me

f: أَرْجُوكَ تُذْهِبُ مَا عِندِي مِنَ الأَوَدِ
b: I implore You that You remove from me any crookedness
I implore You to guide me, direct me to the right path

f: لِمَا هُوَ الْحَقُّ فِي فِعْلِي وَمُعْتَقَدِي
b: to what is The Truth in my action and my faith
implore You to suffice me and enrich me

f: بِفَضلِكَ اللهُ يَا رُكْنِي وَيَا سَنَدِي
b: By Your grace, O Allah, O My Pillar, and O My Support.
I implore You to gaze upon me, I implore You to aid me

f: أَرْجُوكَ تُصلِحَ لِـي قَلبِي مَعَ جَسَدِي
b: I implore You to rectify for me, my heart along with my body
I implore You to protect and safeguard me

f: يَا رَبِّ مِنْ شَرِّ ذِي بَغْيٍ وَذِي حَسَدِ
b: O My Lord, from the evil of the one who transgresses and the one who envies
I implore You to grant me life and cause me to die...
in a state in accordance with knowledge and assurance, goodness and guidance upon the right path.
I implore You that you treat me reverentially and exalt me in status
I implore You to grant me residence in the garden of eternity
Alongside kinship and loved ones, You surround us

f: بِالْفَضْلِ وَالْجُودِ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَيَومَ غَدِ
b: with grace and benevolence, in this life and the hereafter
I direct my face to You, O Allah, in destitution
for the attainment of Your flowing favors, without end
I haven’t ceased, extending my hands, earnestly supplicating
to You in both states of need and prosperity
and declaring, with a sense of indigence that never departs from me,

f: يَا سَيِّدي يَا كَريمَ الوَجْهِ خُذْ بِيَدِي
b: Oh my Master, O Whose grace reflects in every manner, please aid me
O the Full Moon has risen over us
From the valley of wadāʿ
It is an obligation on us to show gratefulness
When a caller calls to Allah
O you who has been sent amongst us
You have come with the obeyed command
You have come and ennobled Al-Madina
Welcome O best of callers
Welcome our chosen one
Your precious light has illuminated
Despire the disbelievers
Its' overflow has flooded the lands
The sun of perfection has risen
By you O beautiful of beauty
Exalted is the One who has fashioned you truly
Always seeking the good
The chosen of the Creator Muhammad
The pearl of the universe
Praising him is the balsam of my spirit
And it is sweet to listen to
O seal of the prophets
O leader of the Awliyā'
A mercy you were sent, Taha
A savior after the loss
Mercy from Allah is gifted
To you from us and greetings of peace
O Aba l-Qasim O you
Whose command is always obeyed
May Allah send his blessings on Muhammad,
may Allah send his blessings and peace upon him
May Allah send his blessings on Muhammad,
may Allah send his blessings and peace upon him
I have passion in my heart that no one knows,
except for the one who lives in it
Whether I show it or hide it,
it only belongs to the messenger of Allah.
May Allah send his blessings on Muhammad,
may Allah send his blessings and peace upon him
May Allah send his blessings on Muhammad,
may Allah send his blessings and peace upon him
O the people I love, take me
to my beloved and leave me there
Leave me and don’t take me back
from Al Rawda of Allah’s messenger
May Allah send his blessings on Muhammad,
may Allah send his blessings and peace upon him
May Allah send his blessings on Muhammad,
may Allah send his blessings and peace upon him
On the hill of sand I call on you,
here my beloved people
This is the valley
where Allah’s messenger used to live
May Allah send his blessings on Muhammad,
may Allah send his blessings and peace upon him
May Allah send his blessings on Muhammad,
may Allah send his blessings and peace upon him
Long have I missed him
and the light in his eyes
And the secret flew to him,
longing for Allah’s messenger
May Allah send his blessings on Muhammad,
may Allah send his blessings and peace upon him
May Allah send his blessings on Muhammad,
may Allah send his blessings and peace upon him
In Taiba I praised Taha (another name of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ),
and I called on Allah by Taha
To be brought to Allah,
tender-hearted amongst the tribe of Allah’s messenger
May Allah send his blessings on Muhammad,
may Allah send his blessings and peace upon him
May Allah send his blessings on Muhammad,
may Allah send his blessings and peace upon him
I complained to him about my sins,
and my beloved asked forgiveness for me
And I got back without any faults
from the city of the messenger of Allah
May Allah send his blessings on Muhammad,
may Allah send his blessings and peace upon him
May Allah send his blessings on Muhammad,
may Allah send his blessings and peace upon him
And there I died and was given a new life,
and the soul lives by (the love of) Taha
I felt like I almost conversed with Gabriel عليه السلام
at the Rawda of Allah’s messenger
May Allah send his blessings on Muhammad,
may Allah send his blessings and peace upon him
May Allah send his blessings on Muhammad,
may Allah send his blessings and peace upon him
We felt that he heard us,
the universe was not enough to contain our excitement
Oh Allah gather us with him
around the basin of the messenger of Allah

f: مَا لَذَّةُ العَيْشِ إِلَّا صُحْبَةُ الفُقَرَا
b: What delight is there in life other than the companionship of the fuqara?
They are the sultans, lords, and princes.
So befriend them and learn the ways of their assemblies,
And keep your obligations, even if they ignore you.
Profit from your time and participate always with them,

f: وَاعْلَمْ بِأنَّ الرِّضَا يَخْتَصُّ مَنْ حَضَرَا
b: And know that Divine satisfaction distinguishes one who is present

f: وَلَازِمِ الصَّمْتَ إِلَّا إِنْ سُئِلْتَ فَقُلْ
b: Make silence obligatory unless you are questioned, then say:

f: لَا عِلْمَ عِنْدِي وَكُنْ بِالجَهْلِ مُسْتَـتِرَا
b: ‘No knowledge have I’, and conceal yourself with ignorance.

f: وَلَا تَرَ العَيْبَ إِلَّا فِيكَ مُعْتَقِدًا
b: Regard not any fault, but that acknowledged within yourself
As a manifest, clearly apparent fault, though it be concealed.
Lower your head and seek forgiveness without apparent cause,
And stand at the feet of Justice, making excuses in your own behalf.

f: وَإِنْ بَدَا مِنْكَ عَيْبٌ فَاعْتَرِفْ وَأَقِمْ
b: If a fault appears in you, acknowledge it, and direct

f: وَجْهَ اعْتِذَارِكَ عَمَّا فِيكَ مِنْكَ جَرَى
b: Your pleas toward that within you which comes from you.
Say: ‘Your slaves are more worthy than ourselves of your forgiveness
So excuse us and be kind to us, Oh Fuqara
By giving preference to others they are exalted, for it is in their nature,

f: فَلَا تَخَفْ دَرَكًا مِنْهُمْ وَلَا ضَرَرَا
b: So do not fear that they will punish or harm you
And in magnanimity toward the brothers be forever limitless,

f: حِسًّا وَمَعْنًى وَغُضَّ الطَّرْفَ إِنْ عَثَرَا
b: Out of feeling or understanding, and avert your gaze if one of them stumbles.
Observe the Shaykh attentively in his states, for perhaps
A trace of his approval will be seen upon you.
Display earnestness and be eager in his service;

f: عَسَاهُ يَرْضَى وَحَاذِرْ أَنْ تَكُنْ ضَجِرَا
b: Perhaps he will be pleased, but beware lest you see annoyance.
For in his satisfaction is that of the Creator and obedience toward Him,

f: يَرْضَى عَلَيْكَ وَكُنْ مِنْ تَرْكِهَا حَذِرَا
b: He has granted you His good pleasure, so beware lest you forsake it!
Know that the Way of the Folk is now decadent,

f: وَحَالُ مَنْ يَدَّعِيهَا اليَوْمَ كَيْفَ تَرَى
b: And that the state of the one who preaches it today is as you see.
When shall I see the true Folk of God, and how am I to have sight of them,

f: أَوْ تَسْمَعُ الأُذْنُ مِنِّي عَنْهُمُ خَبَرَا
b: Or my ears to hear news of them?

f: مَنْ لِي وَأَنَّـى لِمِثْلِي أَنْ يُزَاحِمَهُمْ
b: How can I or one like me dispute with them

f: عَلَى مَوَارِدَ لَمْ أُلْفِ بِهَا كَدَرَا
b: Over spiritual experiences about which I am not familiar?
I love them, am courteous to them, and follow them,
With my innermost soul- especially one person among them.
They are a folk noble in character; wherever they sit,
That place remains fragrant from their traces.
Sufism guides one quickly by means of their conduct;
A fitting harmony is theirs, delightful to my sight.

f: هُمْ أَهْلُ وُدِّي وَأَحْبَابِي الَّذِينَ هُمُ
b: They are my loved ones, my family, who
Are among those who proudly hold up the Helms of Glory.

f: لَا زَالَ شَمْلِي بِهِمْ فِي اللهِ مُجْتَمِعًا
b: I am united with them still, brought together in God,
And through Him our transgressions are pardoned and forgiven.
So may blessings be upon the Chosen One, our Lord

f: مُحَمَّدٍ خَيْرِ مَنْ أَوْفَى وَمَنْ نَذَرَا
b: Muhammad ﷺ, the best of those who fulfill their vows.
Here we are in the prayer hall of the Pure by the favor
and bounty of our Generous Master, the Most High
We attain abundant blessings and those
who attend, receive priceless gifts
A prayer hall through which we are connected to the Purest
of creation and those who traveled his path
Our highest goal is the Exalted, the Worthy of Worship
Seeing Him and hearing from Him "Peace"
through a connected chain back to the Emigrant
Then to his two sons and (the third) he who was named
'Ubayd; using the diminutive for humility
not for lack of possessions - 'Far from it'
generation after generation the transmission continues
till the inner and outward realities met
in the Jurist who is put forth in rank
with fame in the Intermediary Realm that has become manifest
Muhammad ﷺ, son of 'Ali رضي الله عنه down to those
from whom, till today, the inheritance has completely converged

f: فِي عُمَرَ البَسْمَةُ مِنْهُ قَدْ سُرَّتْ
b: in 'Umar رضي الله عنه whose smile brings joy
to the hearts and removes all distress
and reflects to the onlooker the lights of (the family of) al-Ḥaddād
and the Pride of Existence and Ocean of Noblity
and the son of Aḥmad from the family of al-Saqqāf

f: ثُمَّ الهَدَّارِ لَا يَخَافُ مَنْ لَامَا
b: Then, al-Haddār who feared no one's censure
Cool, by us, the eyes of al-Ḥabīb ('Umar)

f: يَا رَبِّ أَدِمْ لَهُ مِنْكَ رِعَايَةْ
b: O my Lord, forever continue to grant him Your care
and we ask You, O Allah, to make
our gatherings forever connected

f: بِكُلِّ مَا فِي مُصَلَّى أَهْلِ الكِسَا
b: to all that goes one in the Prayer Hall of the People of the Cloak
and make reach us here all that is attained there
For they are the elect, the noble, the purified
it is inconceivable that they would let hopes go unfulfilled
They have given us their oath of loyalty and informed us

f: مَنْ عَرَفْنَا لَوْ نَسُونَا مَا سَيَّبْنَا
b: "Whoever we know, even if they forget us, we will never forget them."

f: فَيَا أَبَا سَالِمٍ قُمْ وَكُنْ لَنَا
b: So, O Abū Sālim rise and be their for us,
with us, and by us, outwardly and inwardly
This is a request that we place
at your door and entrust it to you for tomorrow.
The light of dawn is from the radiance of your face
The sparkle of the night is from the glimmer of your blessed strands of hair
Our master is a treasure of grace. He is a treasure of mercy
He is the guide of the entire nation, showing us the way of the sacred law
On the command of your blessed finger, the trees began to walk, the stones began to speak through your greatness.
The moon was split into two upon gesture of your blessed finger
Angel Gabriel عليه السلام came with glad tidings from Allah on the Night of Ascension
Allah invited you to the heavens and bestowed upon you the honor of intimacy
Muhammad is our benefactor and our leader
Our dignity is in responding to his call
O Muhammad, to you belongs the banner and the crown
O exalted in rank
You were addressed on the night of Isra
And you heard the discourse
And you were granted the greatest intercession
On the Day of Reckoning

f: كُنْ شَفِيعِي يَا مَنْ بُعِثْ رَحْمَة
b: Be my intercessor, O you who was sent as mercy
Mercy to the worlds
Allah, Allah, Allah, Allah
Allah, Allah, Allah, Allah
We (turn to Allah) by mean of the Prophet ﷺ, the Light
and by means of Ṭāhā's son, Aḥmad al-Mashūr
O He who is noble in generosity, O Bestower of gifts
O He who is abundant in bounty and favor
Fill my heart with purity and light
by means of Ṭāhā's son, Aḥmad al-Mashūr
My Lord, ease for me all that I seek
and grant me all goodness and the greatest of gifts
My Lord, make all my time that of joy
by means of Ṭāhā's son, Aḥmad al-Mashūr
We have turn to You through the greatest of mankind
and through 'Alawi's son, the Pole and al-'Aṭṭās
and through the saint, our well known treasure
Ṭāhā's son, Aḥmad al-Mashūr
Our master, Aḥmad who is great in status
a mine of spiritual secrets and gnosis
His outpoutings of blessings are distributed amongst us
by means of Ṭāhā's son, Aḥmad al-Mashūr
Among us, he was the gleaming full moon
he bestowed upon us his beneficial knowledge
and he is watched over by the eye of the Chosen One
Ṭāhā's son, Aḥmad al-Mashūr
How many knowledges have we narrated from him
and we drank from his sealed drink
All our affairs - throughout time - are made easy
by means of Ṭāhā's son, Aḥmad al-Mashūr
He is pure in action and character
His knowledge has encompassed the horizons
in all lands it has been spread
Ṭāhā's son, Aḥmad al-Mashūr
His inner secret continues in his children,
his grandchildren from by daughter and son
and those of his seminaries who loved him
Ṭāhā's son, Aḥmad al-Mashūr
Love for him has resided in my heart
This is, surely, a blessing from my Lord.
His inner state is inscribed in my heart
Ṭāhā's son, Aḥmad al-Mashūr
O beloved of mine, stand quickly in care for us
there is a great need in spirit and thought
Come, come! O Aḥmad al-Mashūr!
Ṭāhā's son, Aḥmad al-Mashūr
My Lord, benefit us through his blessings
and grant us from the secret of his spiritual gusts
Grant us from his abundant portion
Ṭāhā's son, Aḥmad al-Mashūr
Thereafter, may Allah's blessings be upon the beloved
He through whom all objectives are achieved
Every sinner's sin is forgiven
by means of Ṭāhā's son, Aḥmad al-Mashūr
and (Allah's blessings be) upon his family and companions
their followers and patrons thereafter -
to the amount of all visitors who will come visit
Ṭāhā's son, Aḥmad al-Mashūr

f: اللهُ اللهْ يا الله اللهُ اللهْ يا الله
b: My heart finds repose when someone mentions Fāṭima,

f: يا رَبِّ صَلِّ على أَحْمَد أبي فاطِمة
b: the daughter of the Prophet ﷺ, the Chosen One; her lights are everlasting

f: يرْتَاحْ قَلْبِي إِذَا حَدْ قَدْ ذَكَرْ فَاطِمَةْ
b: My heart finds rest whenever Fāṭimah is remembered.
Daughter of the Chosen Prophet, our everlasting light.
She spends her nights swimming in the seas of gnosis of her Lord

f: هِي ذُخْرَنَا هِي جَلَا لِلسُّحُبِ القَائِمَةْ
b: She is our treasure. She casts away the clouds above
The waves of her seas are constantly crashing in lofty stations
Her days and her night she spends in fasting and standing in prayer

f: لَهَا التَّبَتُّلْ إلَى المَوْلَى غَدَتْ هَائِمَةْ
b: She has absolute devotion to the Master. She remains madly in love.
Allah, by Allah, You have a true knower and gnostic
by the right of the our Exalted Master's revelation, she stands

f: تَحْتِ الرِّعَايَةِ مِنْ طَهَ نَشَتْ حَازِمَةْ
b: under the care of Ṭāhā in full resolution

f: هِي نُورُ قَلْبِي وَهِي ذُخْرِي لَنَا رَاحِمَةْ
b: She is the light of my heart and she is my treasure, ever merciful to us

f: نِعْمَ الشَّفِيقَةْ وَلَا هِي عَنَّنَا نَائِمَةْ
b: The greatest of compassionate women, she is never neglectful of us.
She has swords of peril, severe, and deadly
with them we are guarded and warn desperate souls

f: حَوْلَ الحِمَى إِنَّ غَارَاتِ القَوِي قَادِمَةْ
b: Around the sanctuary, the onslaughts of the Mighty are sent forth

f: فِي صَفَّنَا فَاطِمَةْ مَعْنَا أَبُو فَاطِمَةْ
b: In our ranks is Fāṭima and with us is the Father of Fāṭima
Their swords are destructive to all the show enmity
O woe to the people of plots and oppressive souls
O Lord, grant relief to us and suffice us from all tyranny
Bestow upon us complete, continuous, and perfect ease

f: وَعِنْدَ رَشْحِ الجَبِينْ أَحْسِنْ لَنَا الخَاتِمَةْ
b: And when the forehead begins to sweat, grant us the most beautiful of ends

f: بِجَاهِ خَيْرِ الوَرَى ذِي الهِمَّةِ العَازِمَةْ
b: by the ranks of the greatest of creation, he who possesses the most resolute aspirations

f: وَاهْلِ الكِسَا مَعْ ذَرَارِي أُمَّنَا فَاطِمَةْ
b: and by the people of the cloak along with the progeny of our mother Fāṭima
Upon them all may the everlasting blessings of our Lord be
and upon their folk and companions the people of resolute intentions

f: وَمَنْ تَبِعْهُمْ دَخَلْ فِي الفِرْقَةِ الغَانِمَةْ
b: whoever follows them, enters into the saved sect.
My beloved has blessed me with union
and generously granted me favor from Him
At the door of the Beloved, I set down my saddle
In hopes that I will be blessed with communion and union
The people of Allah are the gates of gifts
and the means of (Divine) manifestation and perfection
My beloved has blessed me with union
and generously granted me favor from Him

f: أَيَا قَــمَراً بِهٰذَا العَصْرِ لَأْ لَأْ
b: O moon that shines bright in this era
and its light overwhelms my heart and mind
I throw myself into your sanctuary, seeking asylum
from my lower self and evil deeds
My beloved has blessed me with union
and generously granted me favor from Him
A gaze of Your love brings life to my heart
and the gentleness of your compassion rectifies me entirely
So, raise your hands to the Exalted Master
Who fulfills the greatest requests to those who constantly ask
My beloved has blessed me with union
and generously granted me favor from Him
And call out to He who answers the caller
never withholding the outpouring of His bounty from the one who hopes in Him
Connecting to Ṭāhā, during the greastest union,
will bring to reality all that I ask
What Joy for Us in Muḥammad! ﷺ
What Joy for Us in Muḥammad ﷺ
Divinely Aided religion
appeared with the Prophet ﷺ Aḥmad ﷺ
What Joy for Us in Muḥammad! ﷺ
That is a blessing from Allah .......... Allah!
Favored with the Oft-Repeated Seven,
he embraced their subtle meanings
He has no match in Creation,
and to him Allah sent down (the Qur'ān) ........ Allah!
When he appeared in Mecca,
the moon split for his sake
The clan of Muḍar gloried
in him above all mankind ........ Allah!
Purest of mankind in form,
and greatest in character
In West and East, remembrance of him
endures; and all praise be to Allah ........ Allah!
Invoke blessings on the Best of Mankind,
the Chosen One, the Full Moon
Invoke blessings and peace upon him,
he will intercede for us on the Day of Crowding ........ Allah!

f: اِلْزَمْ بَابَ رَبِّكْ ، وَاتْرُكْ كُلَّ دُونْ
b: Stick to the door of your lord, and abandon all else.
Ask Him for safety from the abode of trials
Let not your heart feel constriction, the temporal world is insignificant
Allah is the decreer of all fates, and the world is merely its manifestation
Let not your worries be a lot
whatever is decreed, will come to pass
Your thought and choices, cast them behind your back
your plans, as well; witness He who created you.
Your Master, the Dominant - indeed, He sees you
Consign to Him all your affairs and beautify your opinions (of Him)
Let not your worries be a lot
whatever is decreed, will come to pass

f: لَوْ وَلِمْ وَكَيفَ قَوْلُ ذِي الحَمَقْ
b: If only, why, and how are the statements of the fools
objecting to Allah who created,
apportioned, and decreed everything in truth
O heart of mine, wake up and abandon impudence
Let not your worries be a lot
whatever is decreed, will come to pass
He, the Most High, has taken responsibility for provisions and livelihood
in a book that was revealed as a light for creation
So, acceptance is an obligation, and resentment is forbidden
Contentment is peace, and greed is insanity
Let not your worries be a lot
whatever is decreed, will come to pass
You and all of creation are servants,
and God does as He will with us
Your worry and stress - Woe to you - will avail nothing
The Divine decree has come, so remain calm
Let not your worries be a lot
whatever is decreed, will come to pass
That which is decreed for others will never reach you
and that which was apportioned for you, you will receive
So, busy yourself with your Lord and that which you are responsible for
in the obligations of reality and the preserved Sacred law
Let not your worries be a lot
whatever is decreed, will come to pass
the Sacred law of the Chosen one, the Guide, the Giver of glad tidiings
the Seal of the Prophets, the radiant full moon
May the blessings of Allah, the All-Powerful Lord
as long as the morning wind bends the branches
Let not your worries be a lot
whatever is decreed, will come to pass
May Allah's blessings be upon Muhammad ﷺ
May Allah's blessings be upon Muhammad ﷺ
May Allah's blessings be upon Muhammad ﷺ
and upon his family, as well as peace
The face of the Beloved appeared
and shone in the early dawn
His light pervaded my heart
so I prostrated myself in awe
He said to me: 'Rise! - and ask of Me!
You will have whatever you desire.
I replied: You. You are enough for me!
Away from You I cannot live!
He said: My slave, there is good news for you
so enjoy the vision.
You are a treasure to My slaves
and you are a remembrance to mankind.
Every good and every beauty
in man has spread from me
The attributes of My essence were hidden
and they were manifested in the existence-traces.
Truly created beings are meanings
set up in images
All who grasp this are
are among the people of discrimination
They will not taste the sweetness of life
those whom are cut off from us
Our Lord, bless the one
whose light has spread through all mankind.
O you who seek effacement

f: فِـي الـلَّـهُ قُـلْ دَائِـمًـا الـلَّـهُ الـلَّـه
b: in Allah, be constant in saying "Allah, Allah!"
And pass away in Him from all else
and witness with your heart; Allah!
Gather all your cares into caring about Him
and you will be sufficed from all else but Allah
Be a servant who belongs to Him alone
and you'll be freed from belonging to other than Allah
Submit to Him and be humble before Him
and you'll be granted a secret that comes from Allah
And invoke with fervor and sincerity
along with the devoted servants of Allah
Conceal it should He reveal Himself to you
through lights which come from the Essence of Allah
"The other," for us, is something that cannot be
for existence is a right that belongs only to Allah
So constantly cut through your veil of illusion
by affirming the pure oneness of Allah
The unity of the Acts appear
at the beginning of the invocation of Allah
And the unity of His Attributes
will come [to you] from love in Allah
And the unity of His Essence
will endow you with the state of subsisting by Allah
Happy is the one who walks the path
of invocation for the sake of Allah
Taking as his guide a living teacher
whose knowledge comes from knowing Allah
He loves him with an unflagging love
and sells his ego for the sake of Allah
And rises for prayer in the night to recite
His Words with a yearning for Allah
And so attains what he is seeking
the power of the knowledge of Allah
Our teaching flows from the stream of a Prophet
the most honored of the creatures of Allah
Upon him be the purest blessings
as numerous as all that is known to Allah
And upon his family and Companions
and all of those who call to Allah
Allah Allah, My Lord
My aid and my sufficiency
How many blessings You have bestowed upon me!
And you continue to be generous and kind towards me
You nourished me (while I was yet) a foetus in the womb
You were with me before my two parents
You created me a Muslim, and were it not
for Your grace, I would not know the Prophet ﷺ
I prostrate, in truth, upon my forehead
yes, and my cheeks and eyes
O Lord, shower blessings upon the Prophet ﷺ
as long as the Oft-Repeated Sura' is recited
And his family and Companions as well
as long as people profit from faith
I ask Allah the Truth that happiness might come
to all those who live in this my time.

f: الله الله الله الله يا مَوْلَانَا
b: Allah Allah Allah, Our Lord
Allah Allah Allah, by all of your Grace!
We are present in the Meadow of the Messenger ﷺ
seeking Allah's contentment and most beautiful acceptance.
O you who are the best to turn to for shelter
we come in humility, lowliness, and awe,
That you might ask Allah to grant us His help and protection
in reaching what we hope for at the time of reckoning.
Yours is an immense station, beyond comparison
and a message that is above every messenger.

f: أَنْتَ بَابُ الإِلَهِ فِي كُلِّ خَيْرٍ
b: You are the door to God in all that is good
Whoso comes to you gains acceptance and union.

f: كُلُّ سِرٍّ فِي الأَنْبِيَاءْ قَدْ أَتَاهُمْ
b: Every mystery of the prophets came from your sublimity
and then was confirmed by scriptures passed down.
In every matter that confronts me I seek intercession with my God
from the Prophet ﷺ, whose intercession is accepted
All who arrive at the abode of a noble
attain their greatest hopes and supplications.

f: قَدْ شَكَرْنَا الإِلَهَ فِي كُلِّ وَقْتٍ
b: We give thanks to God at every single moment
for having blessed us with this visit to the Messenger ﷺ
And also a visit to all the Companions who rest
in the Baqi and the children of Fatima رضي الله عنها,
And also a visit to all the wives and daughters
and the son of the deliverer on the Day of Reckoning
And also a visit to the martyrs of Uhud
and also to the uncle of the Messenger ﷺ.
We ask You by their sanctity for perfect peace and safety
on our journey back home and our arrival.
And we seek deliverance on the Day of Gathering
and safety from all who are ignorant and coarse.
My Lord send blessings that are all inclusive
upon the Prophet ﷺ, his family, bis Companions, and their successors.
My lord send blessings upon the Prophet ﷺ
The precious, precious Messenger of Allah ﷺ
The best of people and upon his family
The precious, precious Messenger of Allah ﷺ
by his beauty, by his majesty
The precious, precious Messenger of Allah ﷺ
by his perfection, by his speech
The precious, precious Messenger of Allah ﷺ
The best of people is Muhammad
The precious, precious Messenger of Allah ﷺ
Virtue is one of his bounties
The precious, precious Messenger of Allah ﷺ
My lord send blessings upon the Prophet ﷺ
The precious, precious Messenger of Allah ﷺ
The best of people and upon his family
The precious, precious Messenger of Allah ﷺ
My Lord has said:(He is) a mercy
The precious, precious Messenger of Allah ﷺ
To the creation was his sending
The precious, precious Messenger of Allah ﷺ
The abode of bliss is his residence
The precious, precious Messenger of Allah ﷺ
And Eternity is before him
The precious, precious Messenger of Allah ﷺ
My lord send blessings upon the Prophet ﷺ
The precious, precious Messenger of Allah ﷺ
The best of people and upon his family
The precious, precious Messenger of Allah ﷺ
So when will I kiss the (piece of) earth
The precious, precious Messenger of Allah ﷺ
Where his sandals used to step
The precious, precious Messenger of Allah ﷺ
And when will I see the Rawda
The precious, precious Messenger of Allah ﷺ
That is full of his gifts
The precious, precious Messenger of Allah ﷺ
My lord send blessings upon the Prophet ﷺ
The precious, precious Messenger of Allah ﷺ
The best of people and upon his family
The precious, precious Messenger of Allah ﷺ
And smell the perfume of the Beloved
The precious, precious Messenger of Allah ﷺ
And rest under his shade
The precious, precious Messenger of Allah ﷺ
And the cup of his drink is passed
The precious, precious Messenger of Allah ﷺ
From the fresh water of his vessel
The precious, precious Messenger of Allah ﷺ
My lord send blessings upon the Prophet ﷺ
The precious, precious Messenger of Allah ﷺ
The best of people and upon his family
The precious, precious Messenger of Allah ﷺ
If only he would visit me!
The precious, precious Messenger of Allah ﷺ
Even if just a glimpse of his image
The precious, precious Messenger of Allah ﷺ
Love from him has appeared
The precious, precious Messenger of Allah ﷺ
And likewise from his descendants
The precious, precious Messenger of Allah ﷺ
My lord send blessings upon the Prophet ﷺ
The precious, precious Messenger of Allah ﷺ
The best of people and upon his family
The precious, precious Messenger of Allah ﷺ
And I love and adore him
The precious, precious Messenger of Allah ﷺ
Truly, for the goodness of his traits
The precious, precious Messenger of Allah ﷺ
There has never come anyone like Muhammad
The precious, precious Messenger of Allah ﷺ
Or a likeness of his likeness
The precious, precious Messenger of Allah ﷺ
My lord send blessings upon the Prophet ﷺ
The precious, precious Messenger of Allah ﷺ
The best of people and upon his family
The precious, precious Messenger of Allah ﷺ
On rocks his footsteps left prints
The precious, precious Messenger of Allah ﷺ
Yet in sand they did not sink
The precious, precious Messenger of Allah ﷺ
And He pointed at the full moon and it divided
The precious, precious Messenger of Allah ﷺ
and split into two halves as if they were crescents of a new moon
The precious, precious Messenger of Allah ﷺ
My lord send blessings upon the Prophet ﷺ
The precious, precious Messenger of Allah ﷺ
The best of people and upon his family
The precious, precious Messenger of Allah ﷺ
The tree trunk cried in longing
The precious, precious Messenger of Allah ﷺ
For his speech and his words
The precious, precious Messenger of Allah ﷺ
He protects the land of Kinana (Egypt) as a master
The precious, precious Messenger of Allah ﷺ
Like a Lion among its cubs
The precious, precious Messenger of Allah ﷺ
My lord send blessings upon the Prophet ﷺ
The precious, precious Messenger of Allah ﷺ
The best of people and upon his family
The precious, precious Messenger of Allah ﷺ
Allah protects a visitor
The precious, precious Messenger of Allah ﷺ
Who walks between his mountains
The precious, precious Messenger of Allah ﷺ
Who walks to him at speed
The precious, precious Messenger of Allah ﷺ
To be a winner on the Day of Recompense
The precious, precious Messenger of Allah ﷺ
My lord send blessings upon the Prophet ﷺ
The precious, precious Messenger of Allah ﷺ
The best of people and upon his family
The precious, precious Messenger of Allah ﷺ
Allah protects his heart
The precious, precious Messenger of Allah ﷺ
With light in all his states
The precious, precious Messenger of Allah ﷺ
And he remains always in his blessings
The precious, precious Messenger of Allah ﷺ
And He increases him in wealth
The precious, precious Messenger of Allah ﷺ
My lord send blessings upon the Prophet ﷺ
The precious, precious Messenger of Allah ﷺ
The best of people and upon his family
The precious, precious Messenger of Allah ﷺ
Then may blessings and peace descend
The precious, precious Messenger of Allah ﷺ
On the Prophet ﷺ and his family
The precious, precious Messenger of Allah ﷺ
As long as al-J'afari sings
The precious, precious Messenger of Allah ﷺ
in praise with words of truth
The precious, precious Messenger of Allah ﷺ
Welcome, O month of Ramadan!
Welcome, O month of worship!
Welcome, O month of Ramadan!
Welcome, O month of felicity.
Welcome, O month of Ramadan!
You are the month of benefit.
Welcome, O best of guests
who brings gifts and increased [rewards].
In you all sins are forgiven
and the pious receives his wish
The doors of divine gifts are opened;
The Lord bestows mercy upon His servants.
Disobedience is changed to obedience
as well as perdition to felicity.
You are the preeminent month;
How great that preeminence is!
In you all gates
of the excellent gardens are opened;
And in you Jahannam is closed
and locked shut.
Good deeds in you are multiplied
over a thousand times and even more.
O Lord, increase us in every good
and grant us complete felicity.
Seal our life with the best
of actions when it ends.
Guide Your servant to what pleases You
and heal his body and heart.
Answer all of our prayers
and grant us each his wish—
All loved ones and friends
who have loved solely for Allah’s sake.
أَعْطِنَا الحُسْنَى إِلَهِي

f: Rectify, O Allah, all of our affairs in this world and the Hereafter.
b: ثُمَّ أَكْرِمْ بِالْزِّيَادَه
وَصَلَاةُ اللهِ تَغْشَى

f: then honor us with the gaze upon You.
b: المُصْطَفَى مَوْلَى السِّيَادَه
Allah, we ask you by the Supreme Name
and the rank of the Chosen One, grant us relief
In the name of Allah, our Master, we begin
and praise Him for His blessings upon us
We seek a way through Him in every matter
the One Who helps creation, Lord of the worlds
And by [His] Names as transmitted in revelation
and those hidden and concealed in the unseen
By every Book the Most High has revealed
and the Quran, which is a healing for the believers
And by the Guide we seek recourse and refuge
and [by] all of the Prophets and Messengers
And [by] all of their Families, Companions, and Followers
we seek the means to draw near
We pray by every faction of the Angels
in my Lord’s unseen [world]
And by all of the scholars who uphold Allah's commands
and all of the awliyā' and righteous
And especially by the Imam, the true Pole
pre-eminent in the Faith, Crown of the Gnostics
who ascended in the station of mastery
uniting the Sacred Law and Inward Certainty
To speak of al-‘Aydarūs, the Pole Saint
cleanses rust from the heart, for those ones who are sincere
Virtuous in Faith, true reviver of the Religion
who guided us and whom we emulate
Nor shall we forget Sa‘d, the Faith’s perfection,
one of immense state, Crown of the Devoted
And its composer, Abu Bakr رضي الله عنه, a noble Imam,
Whom his Lord granted an exalted rank and honor
By them we pray to our Exalted Master
for pardon that includes all who are present
and all-embracing grace, ever hiding faults
and forgiveness for everyone who has sinned
We seal this with a mighty reinforcement
by God’s power, they have no power over us
Allah’s protective veil is lowered over us;
and the Eyes of Allah are focused on us
We conclude with blessings upon Muḥammad
Leader of All and Best of Intercessors.
Pray upon the light, Ahmad
O Muhammad, the Radiance of Every Home.

f: يَـــا مَــنْ خُـــلِـــقْ مِــنْ نُـــورِ رَبِّـــهْ
b: O you who was created from the light of his Lord
O you who was named before being born
Welcome, my beloved
O you who resides in the midst of my heart
In love, you became my sufficiency
These are the decrees of my Lord
Pray upon the light, Ahmad
O Muhammad, the Radiance of Every Home.

f: يَـــا مَــنْ خُـــلِـــقْ مِــنْ نُـــورِ رَبِّـــهْ
b: O you who was created from the light of his Lord
O you who was named before being born
No one has ever been afflicted like me
I am the precious one among my people
And I have stumbled in my ignorance
O breeze of the loved ones, let your fragrance flow.
Pray upon the light, Ahmad
O Muhammad, the Radiance of Every Home.

f: يَـــا مَــنْ خُـــلِـــقْ مِــنْ نُـــورِ رَبِّـــهْ
b: O you who was created from the light of his Lord
O you who was named before being born
O you who looked upon the expanse of Qatbah
You have smelled the fragrance of love
Whoever hasn't smelled love
Has no remedy at all
Pray upon the light, Ahmad
O Muhammad, the Radiance of Every Home.

f: يَـــا مَــنْ خُـــلِـــقْ مِــنْ نُـــورِ رَبِّـــهْ
b: O you who was created from the light of his Lord
O you who was named before being born
My heart is attached to them
In their land and their sky
And I have nothing like them
So bring them near on my day of longing
Pray upon the light, Ahmad
O Muhammad, the Radiance of Every Home.

f: يَـــا مَــنْ خُـــلِـــقْ مِــنْ نُـــورِ رَبِّـــهْ
b: O you who was created from the light of his Lord
O you who was named before being born
How long have I reminisced
Of its days and nights so dear
The land and sea are my wealth
And their harvest springs from my love.
Pray upon the light, Ahmad
O Muhammad, the Radiance of Every Home.

f: يَـــا مَــنْ خُـــلِـــقْ مِــنْ نُـــورِ رَبِّـــهْ
b: O you who was created from the light of his Lord
O you who was named before being born
Oh, if only I had an eye to see
Or if I could be present with them
We tend to the beautiful, then we give thanks
And I am a devoted caretaker

f: الــرَّبُّ صَــلَّــى دَائِــمــاً وَسَــلَّــمْ [ يَــا الله ]
b: The Lord forever sends blessings and peace (O Allah)

f: َــا زَمْــزَمَ الــحَــادِي وَمَــا تَــرَنَّــمْ [ يَــا الله ]
b: as long as the camel driver murmurs and sings (O Allah)
upon the honored one (Grant me something for Allah's sake)
throughout the dark night (Grant me something for Allah's sake)

f: أَرْجُـو إِلَـهِـي ذَا الـكَـرَمْ وَالإِفْـضَـالْ [ يَـا الله ]
b: I put my hope in my God the Possessor of Honor and Beneficence (O Allah)
the Master of All (Grant me something for Allah's sake)

f: يَـفْـتَـحْ عَـلَـى قَـلْـبِـي سَـنِـيَّ الأَحْـوَالْ [ يَـا الله ]
b: that He open upon my heart the loftiest of states (O Allah)
of all that is sublime (Grant me something for Allah's sake)

f: الــرَّبُّ صَــلَّــى دَائِــمــاً وَسَــلَّــمْ [ يَــا الله ]
b: The Lord forever sends blessings and peace (O Allah)
upon the honored one (Grant me something for Allah's sake)

f: مَــا زَمْــزَمَ الــحَــادِي وَمَــا تَــرَنَّــمْ [ يَــا الله ]
b: as long as the camel driver murmurs and sings (O Allah)
throughout the dark night (Grant me something for Allah's sake)

f: مِـمَّـا مَـنَـحْ أَوْتَـادَهَـا وَالأَبْـدَالْ [ يَـا الله ]
b: from that which He granted the Awtād and the Abdāl (O Allah)
the people of perfect states (Grant me something for Allah's sake)
and the Aghwāth, the Aṭwād, and the Aqṭāb (O Allah)
the greatest of people (Grant me something for Allah's sake)

f: الــرَّبُّ صَــلَّــى دَائِــمــاً وَسَــلَّــمْ [ يَــا الله ]
b: The Lord forever sends blessings and peace (O Allah)
upon the honored one (Grant me something for Allah's sake)

f: مَــا زَمْــزَمَ الــحَــادِي وَمَــا تَــرَنَّــمْ [ يَــا الله ]
b: as long as the camel driver murmurs and sings (O Allah)
throughout the dark night (Grant me something for Allah's sake)

f: يَـا الـلّٰـهْ بِـذَرَّةْ مِـنْ مَـحَـبَّـةِ الـلّٰـهْ [ يَـا الله ]
b: O Allah, grant even just an atom's weight of Your love (O Allah)
that will bring life to my heart (Grant me something for Allah's sake)

f: أَفْـنَـى بِـهَـا عَـنْ كُـلِّ مَـا سِـوَى الـلّٰـهْ [ يَـا الله ]
b: and by which, I will cease to perceive everything save Allah (O Allah)
from amongst all the servants (Grant me something for Allah's sake)

f: الــرَّبُّ صَــلَّــى دَائِــمــاً وَسَــلَّــمْ [ يَــا الله ]
b: The Lord forever sends blessings and peace (O Allah)
upon the honored one (Grant me something for Allah's sake)

f: مَــا زَمْــزَمَ الــحَــادِي وَمَــا تَــرَنَّــمْ [ يَــا الله ]
b: as long as the camel driver murmurs and sings (O Allah)
throughout the dark night (Grant me something for Allah's sake)

f: فَـمَـا أُرَجِّـي الـيَـوْمْ كَـشْـفْ كُـرْبَـةْ [ يَـا الله ]
b: So, I seek today the alleviation of tribulations (O Allah)
which I struggle with (Grant me something for Allah's sake)

f: إلَّا أَنْ صَـفَـا لِـي مَـشْـرَبُ الـمَـحَـبَّـةْ [ يَـا الله ]
b: Except, if the drink of love is made pure for me (O Allah)
in a cup of bliss (Grant me something for Allah's sake)

f: الــرَّبُّ صَــلَّــى دَائِــمــاً وَسَــلَّــمْ [ يَــا الله ]
b: The Lord forever sends blessings and peace (O Allah)
upon the honored one (Grant me something for Allah's sake)

f: مَــا زَمْــزَمَ الــحَــادِي وَمَــا تَــرَنَّــمْ [ يَــا الله ]
b: as long as the camel driver murmurs and sings (O Allah)
throughout the dark night (Grant me something for Allah's sake)

f: وَاعْـلَـمْ بِـأَنَّ الـخَـيْـرَ كُـلَّـهْ أَجْـمَـعْ [ يَـا الله ]
b: Know that all good in its entirety, (O Allah)
if you are truly listening, (Grant me something for Allah's sake)

f: ضِـمْـنَ اتِّـبَـاعِـكْ لـلـنَّـبِـيِّ الـمُـشَـفَّـعْ [ يَـا الله ]
b: is found in your following of the Prophet ﷺ granted intercession (O Allah)
So, knock on (his) door. (Grant me something for Allah's sake)

f: الــرَّبُّ صَــلَّــى دَائِــمــاً وَسَــلَّــمْ [ يَــا الله ]
b: The Lord forever sends blessings and peace (O Allah)
upon the honored one (Grant me something for Allah's sake)

f: مَــا زَمْــزَمَ الــحَــادِي وَمَــا تَــرَنَّــمْ [ يَــا الله ]
b: as long as the camel driver murmurs and sings (O Allah)
throughout the dark night (Grant me something for Allah's sake)

f: صَـلَّـى عَـلَـيْـهِ الله مَـا تَـشَـعْـشَـعْ [ يَـا الله ]
b: May Allah bestow blessings upon him as long as illumination (O Allah)
shines forth from each horizon (Grant me something for Allah's sake)

f: فَـجْـرٌ وَمَـا سَـالَـتْ عُـيُـونُ الأَشْـعَـابْ [ يَـا الله ]
b: from the break of dawn, and as long as the streams of valleys (O Allah)
and all the channels that branch forth from them (Grant me something for Allah's sake)
Our Master! Our Master!
O Hearer of our call!
By the sanctity of Muhammad,
do not cut short our hopes!
Our Master! Our Master!
O Hearer of our call!
By the sanctity of Muhammad,
allow us to attain our desire.
Our Master! Our Master!
O Hearer of our call!
By the sanctity of Muhammad,
do not cut short our hopes!
Our Master! Our Master!
O Hearer of our call!
By the sanctity of Muhammad,
O that You cure our sick!
Our Master! Our Master!
O Hearer of our call!
By the sanctity of Muhammad,
do not cut short our hopes!
