Our felicity in this life
and our success in the next,
lays with Khadīja, the Great
and Fāṭima, the Radiant.
O Blessed people of goodness
and constant generostiy,
grant protection to this troubled one -
for you know best about my state.
O Beloved people who possess what is desired
and the abundant gifts,
grant protection to this grieved one -
for you know best about my state.
O Beloved people of favor
and of bounties and forgiveness,
grant protection to this bewildered one -
for you know best about my state.
O Beloved people who grant felicity
and gifts and spiritual sustenance,
grant protection, O Masters,
for you know best about my state.
O Beloved people of urgent assistance
and blessings that are more than sufficient
grant safety to this fearful one -
for you know best about my state
O Beloved people of noble status,
favors for the desperate,
and protection from attacks -
for you know best about my state
O Beloved People of high aspiration.
O People of Determination.
O Camels that bear away (people's) burdens.
Indeed, you know best about my state.
O People of the Household of the Chosen One
whose worth is of the highest value.
Intercede, for this confused one -
for you know best about my state.
O People of the Household of the Guide,
my leader and master,
grant me abundant provisions -
for you know best about my state.
You station is lofty and exalted
and your favors pour forth like heavy rain.
Your radiance is great,
so send me a river
You are the greatest of people.
Your generosity cures hardships.
Intercede for this sinful one -
for you know best about my state.
By the rank of Khadīja, my mother,
who polishes away my sorrows
grant me a portion that is abundant -
for you (O Khādija) know best about my state.
Call out to (Fāṭima,) the Radiant One
whose rank is loftiest
and whose radiance is like the full moon -
for she knows best about my state.
And by her Father, the Chosen One
and the one who accompanied Him in the cave,
and by 'Ali رضي الله عنه, the one who stay back in His place -
for they all know best about my state.
And by the people residing in M'alā
and especially she who resides at its peak.
greet this master
our leader, the Great (Khadīja).
And by the right of the two grandchildren
who were from the Prophet ﷺ, the light of the eye.
And by the rank of the two uncles ('Abbas and Hamza)
Indeed, they know best about my state.
And by the one who possessed the two types of knowledge
and by 'Āisha the light of the eyes
the wife of the greatest of the two created beings -
indeed, she knows best about my state.
and by the remaining wives
who are purest in fragrance
who suffice all in need -
indeed, they know best about my state.
We take the Beloved (i.e., Khadīja) as a means (to Allah),
as well as the Pure, Devoted one (i.e, Fāṭima)
and the Prophet ﷺ, then the companions
so, perhaps it will be an answered prayer.
The greatest of the wives in rank
She received directly from him 'Recite!'
She proposed to Aḥmad whilst he had never yet married
she received from him his youth
All her wealth, she spent it
and gifted it to Ṭāhā
She covered him and comforted him
and main easy for him his difficulties
Allah has granted her the greatest glad tidings
and she has excelled all in mention and honor
She has attained success in the the world and the Next
She embraced Islam before all the companions.
Indeed, in Paradise is a palace
for Khadīja and she is most deserving
The blessings of Allah are continuously descending
over her like the clouds
She succeeded by receiving 'Peace' from Allah
and the good pleasure of the Most Merciful she acheived
She surpassed all terrors
and no reckoning will cause her fear
She lived many years with Ṭāhā
birthing for him children
abundant and pure
and because of her, his family has spread
The Master, Exalted is He, has blessed her
with great distinctions, one after another
He increased her with extra blessings from Him
in Pure Gardens
Of her Mecca boasts
and has become paramount of other lands
and the fragrances of goodness eminate
by affiliation and relationship
Her mention brings life to my heart
She is my pillar and my support
Love of her is my provision for the Gathering
and through her, I hope for reward
O Lord, we ask your for a gaze
by which all harm will be averted
and hasten all that brings joy
such that no tribulation remains for us.
Show us the face of the Messenger ﷺ
Khadīja and the Devoted One
and the elect children of the Radiant one (Fāṭima)
O Lord, hasten to respond (to our call)
O leader of all Prophets, o you my Support,
You are the door to Allah, the one on whom I rely.
In this my dunya and in my afterlife,
O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, take me by the hand.
An oath was sworn "By the star when it declines";
Good health and sickness are not alike.
So divest yourself of the two universes,
except for Love for the Master of the Arabs and non-Arabs.
O leader of all Prophets, o you my Support,
You are the door to Allah, the one on whom I rely.
In this my dunya and in my afterlife,
O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, take me by the hand.
He is the Master of Masters, from the people of Mudar,
The great helper of the people of desert and cities.
He was given signs (ayat) and Suras,
He is the source of wisdom and Sacred Law.
O leader of all Prophets, o you my Support,
You are the door to Allah, the one on whom I rely.
In this my dunya and in my afterlife,
O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, take me by the hand.
Like a moon, good and wholesome is his heart
his character and his way of life.
He is the most pure and select of all people,
A righteous witness for people of right and wrong.
O leader of all Prophets, o you my Support,
You are the door to Allah, the one on whom I rely.
In this my dunya and in my afterlife,
O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, take me by the hand.
No eye has seen, or ever will see,
A human being the like of TaHa.
He is the best who ever left traces on earth,
Pure in character and noble personal traits.

everyone will have their portion of it

b: O Allah, bless us with it. O Allah, bless us with it.
O Allah, bless us with a beautiful end

It is truly an all encompassing tribulation

b: O Allah, bless us with it. O Allah, bless us with it.
O Allah, bless us with a beautiful end
Then, when you die, they come to you
and wash and shroud you

b: O Allah, bless us with it. O Allah, bless us with it.
O Allah, bless us with a beautiful end

b: O Allah, bless us with it. O Allah, bless us with it.
O Allah, bless us with a beautiful end
O Lord, be there for me; O Helper
when the sweat of the forehead flows forth

O Allah, bless us with a beautiful end
O God, allow me to end with certainty

b: O Allah, bless us with it. O Allah, bless us with it.
O Allah, bless us with a beautiful end
Your worldly life is not for you to remain
It is only for you to transition through

b: O Allah, bless us with it. O Allah, bless us with it.
O Allah, bless us with a beautiful end

Do not be like cattle

b: O Allah, bless us with it. O Allah, bless us with it.
O Allah, bless us with a beautiful end

b: O Allah, bless us with it. O Allah, bless us with it.

b: O Allah, bless us with it. O Allah, bless us with it.
O Allah, bless us with a beautiful end

b: O Allah, bless us with it. O Allah, bless us with it.
O Allah, bless us with a beautiful end

by the rank of the father of Fāṭima

f: يَا اللهُ يَا اللهُ يَا اللهُ
b: O Allah, O Allah, O Allah,
by the right of Ṭāhā, the Chosen One, O Lord
Bestow mercy, O God, upon our weak states
we truly are weak people
I drank with him the pure drink
and my life became good and pure.
I longed for his nearness
and connection, so he came quickly to my aid.
There is no state of mine
that alienates me like being shunned away.
All of those who rebuked me
for loving him have not been fair.
For the sake of Allah, he is a true friend
I pledged allegiance to him upon absolute loyalty.
Some have described him to me
and he is exactly as they described.
Being distant from him has caused me to become ill,
and only in unity is the cure.
If I showed bad etiquette
in relation to his right, he pardons me.
Through him, I have become wealthy; for he is my
affluence, my sufficiency, and he is enough.
O bolt of lighting,
that shimmers from his quarters -
you have made manifest my ecstasy
that laid dormant in my soul.
You reminded my of a pledge long past
and the purity of a life that has gone.
I was enveloped in envy
of its (life's) cloak that was donned.
Passed around between us
was a cup of love that is pure.
By it, our souls were pleased
and its (life's) worries all ceased.
hasten to our aid by granting nearness to the Chosen One
Indeed, in love have
our souls greatly increased
So, bestow mercy, O God, upon our weak states
we truly are weak people
We cannot bear with patience
being away from our beloved, nor being shunned
So, alleviate, O God, our hardship
O Best of those who grant relief.
And bestow upon us the blessing
of meeting the Beloved, publicly and in private.
And send blessings, O my Lord, upon
the most exalted of creation in honor,
upon his family, his companions,
and all those who followed them.
Purest prayers
for the beloved my master Muhammad
The fragrance of musk scented the air,
Exciting the heart, its love it declared!
Moving the eyes to shed their tears,
Out of deep love of Muhammad.
Purest prayers
for the beloved my master Muhammad
The Tayba of the Chosen One
Oh people: its love brings nearness!
I wish we were all company,
near our master Muhammad.
Purest prayers
for the beloved my master Muhammad
I wish we would meet the beloved;
His love has become truly wondrous!
I wish we would travel soon,
To the beloved, my master Muhammad.
Purest prayers
for the beloved my master Muhammad
A Rawdah so high, so high!
Its love in the heart, so precious!
It made all the men
in passion-lovers of my master Muhammad
Purest prayers
for the beloved my master Muhammad
Its light is a wondrous light,
Its worth is a worth so high!
In it lives the intercessor,
The most noble of Messengers: Muhammad
Purest prayers
for the beloved my master Muhammad
He who comes to it will not suffer,
Every goodness he will meet!
The house of the best of creation, in truth!
The beloved, my master Muhammad.
Purest prayers
for the beloved my master Muhammad
And we saw him appearing clearly,
His light surpassing the light of day!
The hearts of the people of love flew,
to the beloved my master Muhammad
Purest prayers
for the beloved my master Muhammad
Pour out the tears of the hearts,
And drink the water of the unseen!
Do not think of your sins,
for he will intercede in them, Muhammad!
Purest prayers
for the beloved my master Muhammad
When we see him there, he sees us,
When we visit that blessed place,
The Rawdah in which is our guide,
The beloved my master Muhammad!
Purest prayers
for the beloved my master Muhammad
A day of eid it is for my heart,
When I meet my beloved!
The best of creation, my medicine
The beloved, my master Muhammad!
Purest prayers
for the beloved my master Muhammad
We have come in a group,
Seeking your intercession!
Your beloved law is about obedience,
We have obeyed, oh Muhammad!
Purest prayers
for the beloved my master Muhammad
Our Lord we have come,
From far away we travelled!
Our Lord we ask you to look at us,
by the beloved my master Muhammad!
Purest prayers
for the beloved my master Muhammad
The composer of these written pearls,
(Our Shaykh) from the house of Ja’far,
Is asking you for Your grace most great,
by the beloved my master Muhammad!
O Lord, send Your mercy upon Muhammad
O Lord, send Your mercy and peace upon Muhammad.
O Lord, send Your mercy upon Muhammad
Your Beloved One, the Intercessor, whose intercession is accepted
O Lord, send Your mercy upon Muhammad
Most lofty of mankind in station and most exalted
O Lord, send Your mercy upon Muhammad
Highest and most vast of creation in rank
O Lord, send Your mercy upon Muhammad

aid me and hasten to my urgent assistance.

for indeed, our Master responds to the call of the beseecher.

f: يَا رَسُولَ اللهْ قُمْ يَا مَخَلِّصْ مَنْ بُلِي

b: You are the one in whom hopes are put at the terrifying place of standing
Peace; peace - like the fragrant seal of musk -
upon you, my beloveds, O noble ones

f: وَ مَنْ ذِكْرُهُمْ أُنْسُنَا فِي الظَّلَامْ
b: Those whose mention is our comfort in the darkness

f: وَ نُورٌ لَنَا بَيْنَ هَذَا الأَنَامْ
b: and a light for us amongst this creation
You have resided in my heart. By the Lord of creation

f: وَ أَنْتُم مَرَامِي وَ أَقْصَى المُرَادْ
b: and you are my aim and the furthest of my goals
Will you not then bless me with the pure drink of love
and will you bestow upon me the noblest of stations
I am your servant, O people of true loyalty

f: وَ فِي قُرْبِكُمْ مَرْهَمِي وَ الشِّفَا

Do not cause me illness by long periods of distance

f: وَ مُنُّوا بِوَصْلٍ وَ لَوْ فِي المَنَامْ
b: and bless me with union, even if in a dream
I die and live upon your love

f: وَ ذُلِّي لَدَيْكُمْ وَ عِزِّي بِكُمْ
b: and my humility lies before you and my honor is through you

f: إِلَى البُعْدِ عَنْ أَهْلِهِ وَ الوَطَنْ
b: at distance from its people and its homeland

f: وَ مَنْ حبُّهُمْ فِي الحَشَا قَدْ قَطَنْ
b: And those whose love has inhabited my heart
and covered all of my bones
When the mention of the beloved passes my heart

f: وَ وَادِي العَقِيقِ وَ ذَاكَ الكَثِيبْ
b: and the Valley of the Canyon and that sand dunes
it sways like the moist reed
and quakes from its love and yearning

f: أَمُوتُ وَ مَا زُرْتُ ذَاكَ الفِنَا
b: I will die having not visited that courtyard

f: وَ تِلْكَ الخِيَامَ وَ فِيهَا المُنَى
b: and those tents containing within them all bliss

f: وَ لَم أَدْنُ يَوْماً مَعَ مَنْ دَنَا
b: I have not drawn near, a single day, with those who drew near
to kiss the face and drink the wine
If this is the case, then how great is my alienation?

f: وَ يَا طُولَ حُزْنِي وَ يَا كُرْبَتِي
b: How long is my grief and how is my calamity

f: وَ لِي حُسْنُ ظَنٍّ بِهِ قُرْبَتِي
b: I have beautiful opinions that I will be near to you

f: بِرَبِّي وَ حَسْبِي بِهِ يَا غُلَامْ
b: to my Lord and my Sufficiency, O student
Perhaps Allah will cure the pain of being shunned
through union with the beloveds and unfettering the shackles
For my Lord is Merciful, Generous, and Loving
He bestows generously who he wills with attainment
My Lords knowledge has sufficed me
from asking or choosing
For my dua and my agonizing supplication
is a witness to my poverty
For this secret I make supplication
in times of ease and times of difficulty
I am a slave whose pride is in
his poverty and obligation
My Lords knowledge has sufficed me
from asking or choosing
O my Lord and my King
You know my state
And what has settled in my heart
of agonies and preoccupations
Save me with a gentleness
from You, You, O Lord of Lords
Oh save me, Most Generous
before I run out of patience
My Lords knowledge has sufficed me
from asking or choosing
O One who is swift in sending aid
I ask for aid that will arrive to me swiftly
It will defeat all difficulty and it will bring
all that I hope for
O Near One Who answers
and All-Knowing and All-Hearing
I have attained realization through my incapacity,
my submission and my brokenness
My Lords knowledge has sufficed me
from asking or choosing
I am still standing by the door,
so please my Lord have mercy on my standing
In the valley of generosity, I am in solitary retreat
So, Allah, make my retreat here permanent
And I'm abiding by good opinion (of You)
For it is my friend and ally
And it is the one that sits by me and keeps me company
All day and night
My Lords knowledge has sufficed me
from asking or choosing
There is a need in my soul, O Allah
so please fulfill it, O Best of Fulfillers
And comfort my secret and my heart
from its burning and its shrapnel
In pleasure and in happiness
and as long as You are pleased with me
For joy and expansion is my state
and my motto and my cover
My Lords knowledge has sufficed me
from asking or choosing

f: لَا اِلَهَ اِلَّا الله لَا اِلَهَ اِلَّا الله
b: There is no God except Allah, There is no God except Allah

f: لَا اِلَهَ اِلَّا الله مُحَمَّد رَسُولُ الله
b: There is no God except Allah, Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah ﷺ

f: سَلَامٌ عَلَى قَبْرٍ يُزَارُ مِنَ البُعْدِ
b: Greetings of peace upon a grave that is visited from far
greetings of peace upon al-Rawdah and in it is Muhammad

f: سَلَامٌ عَلَى مَنْ زَارَ فِي اللَّيْلِ رَبَّهُ
b: Greetings of peace upon the one who visited his Lord in the night,
so He gave him what is desired in every aspiration

f: سَلَامٌ عَلَى مَنْ قَالَ لِلْضَّبِّ مَنْ أَنَا
b: Greetings of peace upon the one who said to the lizard, “Who am I?”
So he replied, “The Messenger of God, you are Muhammad”

f: سَلَامٌ عَلَى المَدْفُونِ فِي أَرْضِ طَيْبَةَ
b: Greetings of peace upon the one buried in the land of Taybah
and tone who was distinguished by the Merciful with graciousness and nobility
A Prophet that was favored by God with goodness and beauty
So glad tidings for a servant who has visited the grave of Muhammad
O you riding towards al-Madina intending,
convey me Salam to the beloved Muhammad
In his beautiful Rawdah is my hope and desire
and in it is the cure for heart and spirit, and my comfort
If it became distant and difficult for me to visit,
then the image that I hold within me is the best of pictures

f: أُنَزِّهُ طَرْفَ الْعَيْنِ فِي حُسْنِ رَوْضِهَا
b: I delight my eyes in its beautiful Rawdah, so my heart, innermost soul,
and core become free from all worries and grief
So here I am O head of all creation
kissing it in yearning to heal my illness
And send your mercy upon the head of creation, Muhammad

f: صَلَاةً بِهَا تَمْحُو عَنَّا كُلَّ زَلَّةِ
b: A mercy that will wipe from us every slip
There is no god but Allah
There is no god but Allah
Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah ﷺ
Upon him is Allah's prayer
With it, faith is established
With it, safety is obtained
Repeat, O human
There is no god but Allah
Its repetition is so sweet
How splendid, how high
It brings the servant closer to his Master
There is no god but Allah
It has come to us in the news
From the chosen Prophet
That the best of remembrances
There is no god but Allah
It encompasses the meaning of monotheism
And indicates without addition
Repeat, O seeker
There is no god but Allah
Its rememberer will not be miserable
Will not attain separation
It is the firm handhold
There is no god but Allah
It is your strong fortress
It is your solid shield
The remembrance of the Lord of the worlds
There is no god but Allah
With it is success and salvation
In it are all blessings
It saves from all calamities
There is no god but Allah
With it sins are erased
With it good deeds grow
With it goodness is attained
There is no god but Allah
In it is a cure for sickness
In it is strength for weakness
It is the word of piety
There is no god but Allah
It is the healing of the hearts
It is light upon light
The remembrance of your Forgiving Lord
There is no god but Allah
It is the greatest blessing
It is the highest rank
It leaves no pain
There is no god but Allah
It is the healing of ailments
In it is the correction of faults
So remember, do not fear boredom
There is no god but Allah
Adhere to it, O brothers
Illuminate with it the heart
Indeed, the key to the gardens
There is no god but Allah
Adhere to it at dawn
And in the evening and morning
Draw from its lights
There is no god but Allah
Illuminate with it the hearts
Purify with it the sins
Indeed, the greatest sought
There is no god but Allah
It is the greatest mercy
In this world and in the hereafter
The highest of remembrances in reward
There is no god but Allah
Do not neglect it nor
Abandon the glorification of the Master
Indeed, the highest example
There is no god but Allah
Preserve the times
Persist in obedience
It will save you from calamities
There is no god but Allah
It is accompanied by acknowledgment
Of the message of the chosen one
Who has bestowed upon us from lights
There is no god but Allah
The best of creation with Allah
The owner of honor and prestige
The seal of the messengers of God
Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah ﷺ

f: أَلَا يَاللَّه بِنَظْرَةْ مِنَ العَيْنِ الرَّحِيمَةْ
b: O Allah, [I ask You for] a gaze from Your merciful Eye

f: تُدَاوِي كُلَّ مَا بِي مِنْ أَمْرَاضٍ سَقِيمَةْ
b: That heals all the debilitating diseases within me.
O friend, don’t be anxious and irritated,
and submit to the decrees so you are praised and rewarded.

f: وَكُنْ رَاضِي بِمَا قَدَّرَ المَوْلَى وَدَبَّرْ
b: And be content with what the Lord decrees and manages,

f: وَلَا تَسْخَطْ قَضَا الله رَبِّ العَرْشِ الأَكْبَرْ
b: and do not resent the decree of Allah, the Lord of the Greatest Throne.
And be patient and grateful
You will be successful and triumphant
And of the people of secrets

f: رِجَالُ اللهِ مِنْ كُلِّ ذِي قَلْبٍ مُنَوَّرْ
b: The People of Allah, the possessors of luminous hearts,

f: مُصَفَّى مِنْ جَمِيعِ الدَّنَسْ طَيِّبْ مُطَهَّرْ
b: cleansed of all filth, pure and unpolluted.
And this lowly world: its misfortunes are many,
its life is petty, and its time is short.
Only someone whose inner-sight is blind seeks it,

f: عَدِيمِ العَقْلِ لَوْ كَانَ يَعْقِلْ كَانَ أَفْكَرْ
b: his intellect is nonexistent, had he used his intellect he would be more reflective.
He would reflect on its perishing
And the abundance of its difficulties
And how little wealth amounts to

f: فَطُوبَى ثُمَّ طُوبَى لِمَنْ مِنْهَا تَحَذَّرْ
b: So fortunate and happy is he who’s wary of it,
divorces it, and gets down to doing al-Rahmān’s bidding.

f: أَلَاْ يَا عَيْنْ جُودِي بِدَمْعٍ مِنْكِ سَائِلْ
b: O eyes of mine, send plentiful tears

f: عَلَى ذَاكَ الحَبِيبِ الَّذِي قَدْ كَانَ نَازِلْ
b: for that beloved who used to live here.

f: مَعَانَا فِي المَرَابِعْ وَأَصْبَحْ سَفْرَ رَاحِلْ
b: among us in the meadows, but who has now departed,

f: وَأَمْسَى القَلبُ وَالبَالْ مِنْ بَعدِهْ مُكَدَّرْ
b: leaving the heart and mind filled with sorrow in the dark night!
But Allah will suffice me
and all is His to command

f: وَلَا يَبْقَى سِوَى اللَّه (أَلَا يَاللَّه بِنَظْرَةْ)
b: and naught endures but Allah

f: عَلَى البَشَّارْ جَادَتْ سَحَائِبْ رَحْمَةِ البَرّ
b: May clouds of mercy from the Most Kind rain down on Bashshār
and my Lord greet and bring them joy, news of His good pleasure.
And likewise for our masters, our teachers and the gnostics,
our families and loved ones, and all who dwell in my heart;

f: وَمَنْ هُمْ فِي سَرَائِرْ فُؤَادِي قَاطِنُونَا
b: Those who are in my inmost heart.

f: بِسَاحَةْ تُربُهَا مِنْ ذَكِيِّ المِسْكِ أَعْطَرْ
b: May they live forever upon that plain whose dust is more fragrant yet than pure musk.
Tombs of the best of masters,
the leaders of all mankind,
to love them is true fortune!

f: أَلَا يَابَخْتَ مَنْ زَارَهُمْ بِالصِّدْقِ وَانْدَرْ
b: Lucky are those who visit them sincerely,
and who pledge to them to strive, so all that they seek is granted to them.
May the blessings of Allah shroud
the most noble of the pure Messengers
and encompass the prophetic family entirely
as long as the light of the stars remains evident.
True fortune has come upon us
along with success from all directions
For us is the ultimate glad tidings of fortune
which has come to us from the greatest of those who bestow gifts.
O how beauty has manifest
in the eastern lands and the west.
Welcome to you! As family and burdenless
O greatest of beloveds
Welcome as family to a sun
that has effaced all gloom.
Welcome as family to a sun
in which all the stars has receded
O noble of origins, we have taken refuge
in you for all calamaties.
You are the refuge of all sinners
You are the shelter for all the penitent.
You have come from the most established of roots
that could ever have descended upon the heads
from Quṣayy and Lu'ayy,
lofty in majesty, the son of Ghālib.
You majesty is exalted in honor
in the most elevated of ranks.
We remain in total joy
for you, O Possessor of lofty traits.
So how much has the day you came to existence
manifest for us great wonders.
It brought glad tidings of Divine gifts,
matters of hope, and lofty pursuits.
We have drinken - due to our purity
in you - of the sweetest of drinks.
So only for the Lord is all praise
such that no reckoner could every enumerate.
And for Him is all gratitude for
all the Divine gifts He bestowed.
O Generous! O Mericiful!
Grant out of Your generosity and hasten for us the fulfillment of all goals.
Whoever turns towards Your door,
never returns therefrom disappointed.
Forgive, forgive the sins of a slave
who has come towards You in repentance.
O, The best of creation!
Spare a glance towards me
You are nothing but
A treasure of gifts
O ocean of excellence
And crown of justice
Extend towards me a connection out of your generosity
Before the trials of death
O, The best of creation!
Spare a glance towards me
You are nothing but
A treasure of gifts
Far be it from you to forget
About us and treat us miserly
O best of messengers
Have mercy on my pathetic state!
O, The best of creation!
Spare a glance towards me
You are nothing but
A treasure of gifts
How much I have called out
Oh, the best of guides
You are my aspiration, my goal
Show gentle affection towards me
O, The best of creation!
Spare a glance towards me
You are nothing but
A treasure of gifts
I gift you, O my love
Salutations of my Lord
As long as my heart
Is alive with remembrance
Peace be upon you, O Jewel of the Prophets
Peace be upon you, O Most Mindful of the Righteous
Peace be upon you, O Most Pure of the Pure
Peace be upon you, O Most Serene of All
Peace be upon you from the Lord of the Heavens
Peace be upon you forever without end
Peace be upon you, O Aḥmad, O Beloved of Mine
Peace be upon you, O Ṭāhā, O Healer of Mine
Peace be upon you, O My Fragrance and Perfume
Peace be upon you, O who is foremost in leadership
May Allah's blessings be upon you
Peace be upon you, O one who is crowned with nobility
May Allah's blessings be upon you
Peace be upon you, O one who is shaded by the clouds
May Allah's blessings be upon you
Peace be upon you, O one granted intercession on the Day of Standing
May Allah's blessings be upon you
The love of the Prophet ﷺ and his Family is my way,
My true and certain path
My support at every moment,
And by it, I am never wronged or harmed
For the sun reflects but a portion of his light,
And the full moon only a type of his radiance
And all creation wanders, bewildered by his meaning,
None can fully grasp that lofty station
The love of the Prophet ﷺ and his Family is my way,
My true and certain path
My support at every moment,
And by it, I am never wronged or harmed
O People of the Pure Household, count us among your own,
O men of God, show us your tenderness
Look upon us with the softness of your gaze,
For we are the servants to your servants
The love of the Prophet ﷺ and his Family is my way,
My true and certain path
My support at every moment,
And by it, I am never wronged or harmed
Be sincere in your love for them, do not be heedless,
Be a true servant, a servant of God
Do not neglect what He has commanded,
And follow the path of the people of God
The love of the Prophet ﷺ and his Family is my way,
My true and certain path
My support at every moment,
And by it, I am never wronged or harmed
Ah! My weakness has grown,
My worries and confusion have increased
But through my praise of the Messenger ﷺ,
I am healed of every ailment
The love of the Prophet ﷺ and his Family is my way,
My true and certain path
My support at every moment,
And by it, I am never wronged or harmed
I send my prayers and peace
To the guiding Prophet of Tihāmah
And to his noble Family and blessed Companions,
Through them, we hope for a beautiful ending
O Knower of our inner-states,
do not expose us
Grant us ease and pardon us
and be with us wherever we are
My Lord, Knower of all states,
to you I direct all hopes
Bestow upon us your Divine attention,
be with us, and rectify the minds
O Knower of our inner-states,
do not expose us
Grant us ease and pardon us
and be with us wherever we are
My Lord, O Lord of Lords!
Your slave and impoverished one is at the door
He has come having severed all other means
seeking to make amends after having strayed
O Knower of our inner-states,
do not expose us
Grant us ease and pardon us
and be with us wherever we are
O Expansive in generosity, (we seek) Your generosity
All good is Yours and possessed by You
(that which is) beyond what Your slave could seek.
So, repair with Your mercy right now
O Knower of our inner-states,
do not expose us
Grant us ease and pardon us
and be with us wherever we are
O Originator of all creation!
O Granter of all expansive kindness!
I ask that You cast down a veil
upon all foul actions and foolishness
O Knower of our inner-states,
do not expose us
Grant us ease and pardon us
and be with us wherever we are
O One who sees the reality of my heart!
Your awareness truly suffices me
So, erase with Your pardon my sin
and make right my intentions and deeds
O Knower of our inner-states,
do not expose us
Grant us ease and pardon us
and be with us wherever we are
My Lord! Upon You is my reliance
as well as my dependence is in You
- in truthfulness, and my furthest aim
is Your eternal sweet pleasure.
O Knower of our inner-states,
do not expose us
Grant us ease and pardon us
and be with us wherever we are
My Lord, My Lord! Indeed I
ask You to pardon me
My opinion has never been at loss regarding You
O Owner of all dominion, O Guardian!
O Knower of our inner-states,
do not expose us
Grant us ease and pardon us
and be with us wherever we are
I complain to You, as I weep,
of the ills of my injustice and falsehood
and the evil of my deeds and my abandonment
and of my whimsical speech
O Knower of our inner-states,
do not expose us
Grant us ease and pardon us
and be with us wherever we are
and (I complain) of love of this blameworthy world
that is barren of any goodness
In it all tribulations reside,
and it is filled with tribulations and preoccupation
O Knower of our inner-states,
do not expose us
Grant us ease and pardon us
and be with us wherever we are
O Woe to my soul that decieves
from the straight path;
it continuously urges me
and its aim is toward status and wealth
O Knower of our inner-states,
do not expose us
Grant us ease and pardon us
and be with us wherever we are
My Lord, it has overpowered me
and imprisoned me with false hopes
and in pleasures it has weakened me
and shackled me in fetters
O Knower of our inner-states,
do not expose us
Grant us ease and pardon us
and be with us wherever we are
I seek Your assistance, my Lord,
in the treatment of my heart
and the loosening of the knot of my afflication.
Look, then, at the sadness that circles.
O Knower of our inner-states,
do not expose us
Grant us ease and pardon us
and be with us wherever we are
My Lord, O Best of those who suffice!
Descend all ease upon us
for there is nothing hidden
from You, small or large.
O Knower of our inner-states,
do not expose us
Grant us ease and pardon us
and be with us wherever we are
My Lord, Your slave is at Your door.
He fears the painfulness of Your torment
and hopes for Your reward
and the ever abundant downpour of Your mercy.
O Knower of our inner-states,
do not expose us
Grant us ease and pardon us
and be with us wherever we are
He has come to You with his excuses,
his brokeness, and poverty,
so defeat with ease from You his difficulty -
by Your sheer generosity and bounty.
O Knower of our inner-states,
do not expose us
Grant us ease and pardon us
and be with us wherever we are
Bless him to make such a repentance
that washes him of all sin.
Protect him from the evil consequences
of all that has transpired from him.
O Knower of our inner-states,
do not expose us
Grant us ease and pardon us
and be with us wherever we are
For You are the Master of all
the Unique in perfection.
In exaltation, and loftiness
You are beyond any stricken example.
O Knower of our inner-states,
do not expose us
Grant us ease and pardon us
and be with us wherever we are
Your generosity, Your bounty, and Your kindness
are hoped for; Your might and Your dominance
are feared; Your remembrance and Your gratitude
are incumbent, as is Your praise and magnification.
O Knower of our inner-states,
do not expose us
Grant us ease and pardon us
and be with us wherever we are
My Lord, You are my helper.
Incite me all the good in me
and make Your gardens my final abode
and seal with faith the lifespans.
O Knower of our inner-states,
do not expose us
Grant us ease and pardon us
and be with us wherever we are
Send blessings in every state
upon he who effaced misguidance,
he to whom the gazelle spoke,
Muhammad ﷺ, the guide, the leader
O Knower of our inner-states,
do not expose us
Grant us ease and pardon us
and be with us wherever we are
And all praise is due to Allah along with gratitude
for all His blessings that never cease.
We praise Him privately and publicly
by morning and night.
Muhammad is the most delightful to one's sight
The door of the one God
Send salutations upon him repeatedly
You will find bliss and be happy
He is the door of hope wherein is salvation
Whoever seeks refuge in him will not be disappointed.
So extend to him the upturned hand of hope
For he is the most beloved Muhammad
Muhammad is the most delightful to one's sight
The door of the one God
Send salutations upon him repeatedly
You will find bliss and be happy
Whoever loves Taha the Chosen One
Will be satisfied from every worry
And within praise of him is the cure
His position is not denied
Muhammad is the most delightful to one's sight
The door of the one God
Send salutations upon him repeatedly
You will find bliss and be happy
May God send salutations upon him as long
As the full moon in the sky smiles down
And his family, as long as rain pours down
And the chanter recites poems of praise

f: عَلـَى فِنـَا بَابْ مَوْلَانـَا طَرَحْنـَا الحَمُول
b: At our Lord’s doorstep we have placed our burdens,
hoping to receive from Him gifts, contentment, and acceptance

f: يَافَرْدْ يَا خَيْرْ مُعْطِي هَبْ لَنَـا كُلَّ سُولْ
b: O Singular One, O Best of Givers, grant us every request,

f: وَاخْتِمْ لَنَا مِنْكَ بالحُسْنـَى نـَهَارَ القُفُولْ
b: and give us a good seal from You when life comes to an end.

f: وَهَبْ لَنَا القُرْبْ مِنَّكْ وَالْلِّقَا وَالوُصُول
b: Grant us nearness to You and an excellent meeting,

f: عَسَى نُشَاهِدَكْ فِي مِرْأةْ طَهَ الرَّسُول
b: and arrival so that we may witness You through the mirror of Ṭa-Hā, the Messenger ﷺ

f: يَارَبَّنَا انْظُرْ إِليْنَا وَاسْتَمِعْ مَا نَقُول
b: Our Lord, gaze upon us and hear what we say.

f: وَاقْبَلْ دُعَانَا فَـاِنَّا تَحِتْ بَابَكْ نُزُول
b: Accept our supplications, for we are standing at Your door.

f: ضِيفَانْ بَابَكْ وَلَسْنـَا عَنْهُ يَاالله نَحُول
b: Guests at Your door, and—O Allah—we will never leave it

f: وَظَنُّنَا فِيكْ وَافِرْ وَ الَْامَلْ فِيهِ طُول
b: We have an immensely good opinion of You and expansive hope

f: وَفِي نـُحُورِ الاَعَادِي بَكْ اِلـَهِـي نَصُول
b: And at the enemies’ throats, with You O Allah, we assault.

f: فِي شَهْرْ رَمَضَانْ قُمْنَا بِالْحَيَا وَالذُّبُول
b: In the month of Ramadan we have risen with modesty and neediness.

f: نبْغَى كَرَامَةْ بِهَا تَزْكُو جَمِيعُ العُقُول
b: We desire a gift with which all our intellects become purified

f: نسْلُكْ عَلَى الصِّدِقْ فِي سُبْلِ الرِّجَالِ الفُحُول
b: so that we become true in following the path of the Great Men of Allah.

f: سُبْلِ التُّقَـى وَ الهِدَايَـةْ لَا سَبِيلِ الفُضُول
b: The path of taqwa and guidance, not the path of prattlers.

f: يَاالله طَلَبْنَاكْ يَامَنْ لَيْسْ مُلْكُهْ يَزُول
b: O Allah, we seek You, O One whose authority never ceases.

f: ثُمَّ الصَّلَاةُ عَلَى المُخْتَارْ طَهَ الرَّسُول
b: Then we send blessings upon the Chosen One, Ṭā-Hā, the Messenger ﷺ.

f: وَ الْاَلْ وَالصَّحْبْ مَا دَاعِي رَجَعْ بِالْقَبُول
b: And the Family and Companions—whenever one’s supplication is accepted.
